comment: 55 pages. Dataset on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chsanleo/strata-s12 - archived on Zenodo: STRATA-S12 corpus https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22699047 ; reduced subset (D_lite) https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22646276
summary: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.

AI.tldr: 该论文把构建共配准Sentinel-1/2自监督预训练语料库视为受约束的最大覆盖问题，提出缺额驱动的分层采集算法DDSA，产出并发布语料库STRATA-S12。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态遥感数据集多为机会式采集，缺乏分层配额控制，且非均匀云覆盖造成地理性缺失，无法保证语料库在(类别×季节×区域)各层上的均衡覆盖与时相配对质量。
AI.method: DDSA在半球校正后的(类别×季节×区域)分层上构建约束最大覆盖问题，强制严格时间配对与多阶段质量门控，并在采集过程中引入人在回路的缺额修复阶段闭环迭代。
AI.result: 缺额优先排序使部分运行亦具备覆盖性，192个分层在预算最初几个百分点即全部填充；失败可修复性取决于成因的时间持续性，几何类失败(如nodata)修复率η=41.4%，云类仅18.8%；修复回路贡献39.5%的发布配对且无显著质量损失，人工复核通过率89.8%；2,928,370次采集尝试最终发布740,746对；发布STRATA-S12及STAC/PDS4对齐的FAIR附属文件，预注册线性探针验证其适于自监督预训练，并与SSL4EO-S12、SEN12MS做元数据级覆盖比较。
AI.conclusion: 将语料库构建形式化为受约束最大覆盖问题并配合缺额驱动排序与闭环修复，可显著提升分层覆盖均衡性与采集效率，但高质量保证需付出较高采集代价；跨语料库与跨方法的系统性比较留待后续工作。

title: Hierarchical Curriculum Learning for Surgical Video Generation: Focusing on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach Robotic Thyroidectomy Datasets
summary: High-fidelity surgical video generation is increasingly important for surgical education, simulation, and downstream AI training, as conventional simulation pipelines are limited by cost, realism, and scenario diversity. Adapting generic text-to-video diffusion models to surgical procedures remains difficult, however, due to complex anatomical structures, intricate tool-tissue interactions, the inherently hierarchical nature of surgical workflows, and the scarcity of curated training data outside a few well-studied procedures. We propose a surgical video generation framework that combines hierarchical procedural annotation with curriculum transfer learning. Surgical procedures are decomposed into three levels (phase, task, and action) and a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model is progressively adapted from coarse to fine-grained surgical context, supported by a dynamic sampling strategy that handles variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips. We instantiate the framework on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach robotic thyroidectomy, a procedure for which no curated benchmark currently exists. Relative to the preceding task-level model, the final action-level model reduces FVD by 20.1% and FID by 15.7%, and a matched-budget ablation indicates that these gains arise from the curriculum design rather than from additional training. A user study with six clinicians rates visual realism highly while highlighting remaining gaps in anatomical accuracy and clinical reliability. The proposed framework offers a step toward AI-driven surgical simulation in procedures where curated data are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化流程标注与课程迁移学习相结合的手术视频生成框架，在缺乏基准的机器人甲状腺切除术上实现FVD降低20.1%、FID降低15.7%。
AI.motivation: 高保真手术视频对手术教育、仿真及下游AI训练日益重要，但传统仿真流程受成本、真实感与场景多样性限制；将通用文生视频扩散模型迁移到手术场景存在困难，原因包括解剖结构复杂、器械-组织交互精细、手术流程固有层次性，以及除少数成熟术式外缺乏精选训练数据。
AI.method: 将手术流程分解为三个层级（phase、task、action），把预训练文生视频扩散模型按由粗到细的手术语境进行渐进式课程迁移学习，并配合动态采样策略以处理变分辨率、变时长的视频片段。框架实例化于双侧腋乳入路机器人甲状腺切除术。
AI.result: 相比前一task级模型，最终action级模型FVD下降20.1%、FID下降15.7%；等预算消融实验表明增益源自课程设计而非额外训练量。六位临床医生的用户研究给出较高的视觉真实感评价，同时指出解剖准确性与临床可靠性仍存差距。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在精选数据稀缺的术式中开展AI驱动的手术仿真迈出了探索性一步。

title: LatentRiskBench: Measuring State-Dependent Risks in Enterprise Agents
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 18 pages, 3 figures
summary: Enterprise agents face safety risks that cannot be determined from individual actions alone. Existing safety benchmarks largely evaluate action-local risks, overlooking failures whose safety depends on workflow state. In such state-dependent risks, the same action may be safe in one context but violate policy in another. Hence, we introduce LatentRiskBench for evaluating such state-dependent risks in enterprise settings. It pairs risky trajectories with benign counterparts that share the same terminal action but differ in latent policy-relevant states, requiring models to reconstruct workflow context rather than rely on action-level cues. We also introduce new metrics for state-dependent risk evaluation, including a suite of residual risk (RR) measures. Experiments on the benchmark show that action-level evaluation detects only 0.09 of state-dependent violations, whereas state-level evaluation reaches 0.96. Existing guardrail methods largely overlook such risks unless they are explicitly applied to workflow states. Case studies on a commercial deployed scenario further show that the safety metrics embedded in the benchmark provide a more realistic measure of safety for enterprise agents. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/JingyueCong/LatentRiskBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LatentRiskBench，用于评估企业智能体中依赖工作流状态的潜在风险，并引入残余风险（RR）等新指标。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体的安全风险无法仅从单个动作判定：同一动作在不同工作流状态下可能安全也可能违规。现有安全基准主要评估动作局部风险，忽略了依赖状态的失败模式。
AI.method: 构建 LatentRiskBench，将风险轨迹与良性轨迹配对，二者终端动作相同但潜在政策相关状态不同，迫使模型重建工作流上下文而非依赖动作级线索；并提出用于状态依赖风险评估的新指标，包括一套残余风险（RR）度量。
AI.result: 实验显示，动作级评估仅能检测出 0.09 的状态依赖违规，而状态级评估达到 0.96；现有防护栏方法除非显式应用于工作流状态，否则大多忽略此类风险。商业部署场景的案例研究进一步表明，基准内嵌的安全指标能更真实地衡量企业智能体安全性。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖风险是企业智能体安全评估的关键盲区，必须从工作流状态层面进行建模与防护；LatentRiskBench 及 RR 指标为更现实的安全评估提供了基准与工具。

title: Encoding Context into LLM Weights: What Makes It Context?
summary: Longer contexts allow large language models (LLMs) to condition their predictions on more information, but inference costs grow prohibitively with context length. An emerging alternative uses test-time updates to encode context as temporary changes to model weights. However, encoding this information into weights that already represent general knowledge obscures its role as context, so the LLM may fail to use it properly to condition subsequent inference. To restore this contextual role, we first associate each context with an identifier during encoding, thereby distinguishing the newly encoded information from pre-existing knowledge. Invoking the identifier at inference then enables the LLM to recite the encoded context. Nevertheless, successful recitation does not ensure that the LLM will use the recalled information as context. We therefore further introduce a prompting framework that explicitly guides the LLM to use this information as context. Across diverse controlled tasks and practical benchmarks, our method outperformed the baseline using only off-the-shelf LLMs, showing its advances in context encoding.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对"用测试时权重更新来编码长上下文"这一新范式，指出将上下文信息写入已有权重会模糊其"上下文"身份，导致模型无法正确使用；作者通过为每个上下文绑定标识符并在推理时调用该标识符，再结合显式引导模型把召回信息当作上下文的提示框架，从而恢复上下文角色，提升效果。
AI.motivation: 长上下文虽能让LLM利用更多信息进行预测，但推理成本随上下文长度急剧增长。已有的替代方案是用测试时更新把上下文编码为模型的临时权重变化，从而降低推理开销；但问题是，这些新信息被写入本身就代表通用知识的权重中，其"上下文"身份被模糊，模型可能无法正确地把它作为上下文来条件化后续推理，即"记住了"却"用不对"。
AI.method: 方法分两步：1）在编码阶段为每个上下文关联一个标识符（identifier），使新编码的信息与模型原有知识相区分，推理时通过调用该标识符即可让模型复述该上下文；2）进一步提出一个提示框架（prompting framework），显式引导LLM将召回的信息作为上下文来使用，而不仅仅停留在复述层面。
AI.result: 在多种受控任务和实际基准上，该方法均优于仅使用现成（off-the-shelf）LLM的基线，显示出在上下文编码方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 为测试时更新的上下文信息赋予可调用的标识符、并显式提示模型将其作为上下文使用，能有效解决"编码进权重后上下文角色被模糊"的问题，在多种任务上超过纯推理基线，证明该思路在降低长上下文推理成本的同时保持了模型对上下文的有效利用。

title: MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation
summary: Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

AI.tldr: MedEvo 利用医学知识（标签分类体系与错误类型诊断）引导失败轨迹的修复与数据选择，仅用 SFT 即可显著提升多模态医学推理模型的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态推理模型通常基于教师生成的推理链训练，丢弃了学生自身失败轨迹中有效的推理内容；而通用领域的纠错方法对图像阅读、解剖语境或鉴别诊断类错误缺乏针对性指导。
AI.method: MedEvo 以标签分类体系和错误类型诊断为导航依据，同时驱动轨迹修复与数据选择：对每条失败 rollout，由"盲金标准审计器"定位首个关键错误并给出最小化、不含答案的提示，学生模型保留有效前缀并重新生成错误后缀；每轮结束后在留出反馈集上识别各医学标签的能力缺口，优先选取相关问题进行新一轮 rollout 与修复。
AI.result: 仅使用监督微调（SFT），MedEvo 将 Qwen3.5-9B 在七个基准上的平均准确率从 65.57% 提升至 69.12%（MedXpertQA-MM 多模态赛道从 47.40% 提升至 54.50%），超过教师蒸馏 SFT（66.93%）；同时将 Qwen3.5-35B 与 Qwen3.5-397B 的平均准确率分别从 67.91% 提升至 73.04%、从 71.83% 提升至 74.95%。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明：失败轨迹中包含值得保留的推理；修复成功并不等同于具备学习价值；独立反馈是持续改进的关键。

title: SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly optimized with object-node and relation-edge classification losses. These objectives encourage exact object and relation label recovery, but they do not directly optimize semantic proximity to the ground-truth scene graph: two wrong graphs can receive comparable penalties even when one is much closer in object roles and relation contexts. A direct graph-distance loss is difficult in general, since graph matching and graph edit distance require correspondence search and edit-cost design. Our key observation is that prior supervised 3D scene graph prediction protocols are conducted on fixed object-node indices and supervised edge slots. This can turn a scene graph comparison into a well-defined aligned graph-distance problem. To this end, we propose SWORD, a Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance that builds block-normalized object and relation ground distance metrics from training scene graph annotations through a deterministic base-to-context order, without external semantic priors. SWORD lifts these metrics to Wasserstein distances over aligned node and null-augmented edge marginals, providing semantic graph-distance supervision beyond exact-label penalties while preserving the ground-truth graph as the unique zero-distance solution in aligned marginal probability space. We prove that SWORD is a strict metric on aligned marginal probabilistic scene graphs, preserves scene-graph-grounded substitution ordering, controls additive graph-grounded semantic observables, and yields a surrogate upper-bounding decoded semantic error.

AI.tldr: 提出SWORD，一种基于对齐图距离的3D场景图预测监督损失，通过Wasserstein距离在对象与关系边际上提供语义图距离监督，超越传统分类损失。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图预测使用对象节点分类与关系边分类损失，鼓励精确标签恢复，但不直接优化与真值场景图的语义接近度；两个错误图即使语义接近也可能受相近惩罚，而通用图距离（图匹配、图编辑距离）需要对应对搜索与编辑代价设计，直接使用困难。
AI.method: 关键观察：已有监督3D场景图预测在固定对象节点索引与监督边槽上进行，可将场景图比较转化为对齐图距离问题。SWORD构建块归一化的对象与关系基础距离度量，通过确定性的base-to-context顺序从训练标注中得到，无需外部语义先验；再将对齐节点边际与空增强边边际上的度量提升为Wasserstein距离，实现语义图距离监督。
AI.result: 在概率场景图上，SWORD被证明为严格度量，保持以场景图为基础的子替换排序，控制可加的场景图语义观测量，并给出解码语义误差的代理上界。
AI.conclusion: SWORD在对齐边际概率空间中保持真值图为唯一零距离解，提供超越精确标签惩罚的语义图距离监督，可作为3D场景图预测的有效监督目标。

title: Pushback in a Haystack: Language Models Respond to Factual Errors Ambiguously and Ineffectively
summary: The sycophancy of language models, or their failure to push back against faulty user input, is now widely studied. However, if LMs do push back, is sycophancy solved? We show that LMs vary in how they present pushback, and thus vary in how effectively they correct user beliefs. We introduce a phrase-level, human-validated response labeling framework to uncover fine-grained insights into how LMs push against and/or affirm false inputs. We develop and apply our framework on model responses in five languages: English, German, Chinese, Hindi, and Yoruba. We find that when models do push back against users' false assertions, they tend to use indirect phrasing and mix in affirmation, with more indirectness in Hindi and Yoruba than in other languages considered. In a large-scale human study (n = 300), we find that the pushback ambiguity we identified may fail to correct and prevent users' factual misconceptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出短语级、经人工验证的回复标注框架，分析五种语言中语言模型如何表达"反驳"，发现模型倾向使用间接措辞并混入肯定，这种模糊性可能无法纠正用户的事实误解。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注语言模型的谄媚行为（即不反驳用户的错误输入），但"模型是否会反驳"并不等于"谄媚问题已解决"。作者认为模型在表达反驳的方式上存在差异，进而影响其纠正用户信念的有效性。
AI.method: 1. 提出短语级、经人工验证的回复标注框架，用于细粒度分析模型如何反驳和/或肯定错误输入；2. 将该框架应用于英语、德语、中文、印地语和约鲁巴语五种语言的模型回复；3. 开展大规模人类被试研究（n=300）评估反驳方式对用户事实认知的影响。
AI.result: 模型在反驳用户错误断言时，倾向使用间接措辞并混入肯定；印地语和约鲁巴语中的间接性高于其他考察语言；人类研究（n=300）表明，这种反驳的模糊性可能无法纠正并预防用户的事实性误解。
AI.conclusion: 即便模型选择反驳，谄媚问题也未必得到解决；反驳的表达形式（间接性和肯定混合）会影响纠错效果。研究提示需从措辞层面评估和改进模型的反驳策略，并关注跨语言的差异。

title: A Differentiable 3D Scene Graph Metric via Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly supervised with local object and predicate classification losses. Although effective for slot-wise label prediction, this formulation does not provide a graph-level semantic distance between a predicted scene graph and its ground truth: semantically mild label errors and structurally disruptive relational errors can be treated similarly, and subject-predicate-object facts are not compared as scene-level units. We propose Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry, a graph-level supervision objective that measures the semantic and structural discrepancy between 3D scene graphs. Our key idea is to reinterpret the conventional classifier outputs of a 3D scene graph predictor as an aligned probabilistic scene graph field, where object and predicate predictions jointly define contextual subject-predicate-object facts. This formulation yields a differentiable metric-based training objective with an efficient factorized implementation and can be applied to existing 3D scene graph prediction architectures without modifying their network design. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate that our supervision improves downstream graph-conditioned 3D scene generation, while ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of the proposed graph-level terms and user studies show better graph descriptiveness, relation plausibility, and structural preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry（CHTG），一种图级监督目标，将3D场景图预测器的分类器输出重解释为对齐的概率场景图场，从而在预测图与真值图之间建立可微的语义-结构度量。该方法无需修改网络结构即可嵌入现有3D场景图预测架构，在3DSSG上提升了图条件3D场景生成，并通过消融与用户研究验证了图级项的作用。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图预测普遍采用局部物体分类与谓词分类损失进行监督。这种槽位级（slot-wise）监督虽然对单标签预测有效，但缺乏预测场景图与真值图之间的图级语义距离：语义上轻微的标签错误与结构上具有破坏性的关系错误可能被同等对待，且主-谓-宾三元事实未被作为场景级单元进行比较，导致监督信号与图的整体语义和结构质量脱节。
AI.method: 核心思想是将3D场景图预测器常规的分类器输出重解释为一个对齐的概率场景图场（aligned probabilistic scene graph field），其中物体预测与谓词预测共同定义具有上下文的主-谓-宾事实。在此基础上构建Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry——一种图级监督目标，用于度量预测场景图与真值场景图之间的语义与结构差异，并给出可微的、基于度量的训练目标，配合高效的因子化实现。该方法可直接应用于现有3D场景图预测架构，无需改动其网络设计。
AI.result: 在3DSSG数据集上的实验表明，该监督方式改善了下游的图条件3D场景生成任务；消融研究证实了所提出的图级项之间具有互补作用；用户研究显示该方法在图描述性、关系合理性与结构保持性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 将3D场景图预测的监督从局部标签分类提升到图级度量，是一种通用且侵入性低的改进思路：通过概率场景图场建模与Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry目标，实现了对语义与结构差异的统一、可微度量，提升了预测图的描述性与结构保真度，并有益于依赖场景图的下游生成任务。

title: From Token Correction to Claim Admission: Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models often exhibit object hallucination, generating claims that are not supported by the input image. To mitigate this issue, we propose Evidence-Guided Visual Claim Admission (EGVCA), a training-free framework that admits a semantic claim only when it receives sufficient image-dependent support. EGVCA measures this support by comparing the claim likelihood under the observed image and a visual-null input. For captioning, it controls semantic expansion without altering token generation. For binary visual question answering, it combines atomic visual support with the image-induced change in the model's native Yes--No margin. Experiments on CHAIR, POPE, and MME across three LVLM backbones show that EGVCA substantially reduces object hallucination while preserving caption quality. It achieves the highest POPE F1 in eight of nine backbone--sampling settings and improves the native MME total score on all three backbones. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of claim-level admission as a simple alternative to token-level distribution correction.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架EGVCA，通过比较图像与视觉空输入下的语义声明似然来过滤幻觉，在CHAIR、POPE、MME上显著降低物体幻觉并保持描述质量。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型存在物体幻觉，即生成图像不支持的内容；已有方法多为token级分布校正，本文探索更简洁的声明级准入思路。
AI.method: EGVCA为免训练框架，仅当语义声明获得充分的图像依赖支持时才予以准入：通过比较该声明在观测图像与视觉空输入下的似然度衡量支持度。用于描述任务时控制语义扩展而不改变token生成；用于二元VQA时结合原子视觉支持与图像引起的Yes-No边界变化。
AI.result: 在三个LVLM骨干上，于CHAIR、POPE、MME实验中大幅降低物体幻觉并保持描述质量；在九种骨干-采样设置中的八种取得最高POPE F1，并在三个骨干上均提升原生MME总分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，声明级准入可作为token级分布校正的一种简单有效的替代方案。

title: SkillScreen: High-Recall Screening of Malicious Agent Skills with Decision Models
summary: Agent skills turn natural-language instructions into actions, creating a security challenge: legitimate automation and malicious behaviour can look deceptively similar. A practical screen must catch nearly every attack while keeping the review load manageable. We present SkillScreen, a compact decision model trained to score skill maliciousness directly from SKILL.md in a single forward pass. On MaliciousSkillBench, SkillScreen flags 20-25% of benign skills at 99% recall on unseen attack families, substantially fewer than the word-level classifier and prompted LLM judges tested. Under the same training protocol, it also generalizes better than a fully fine-tuned encoder to unseen sources. Yet unfamiliar benign sources sharply increase false positives, showing that recognizing new attacks does not ensure reliable screening of new skill collections. Our results demonstrate the value of task-trained decision models for high-recall skill screening. Project page: https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillScreen，一种紧凑决策模型，直接从SKILL.md以单次前向传播对技能恶意性打分。在MaliciousSkillBench上，它在未见攻击族上以99%召回率仅误报20-25%良性技能，优于词级分类器与提示式LLM裁判，并在未见来源上比全量微调编码器泛化更好；但面对陌生良性来源时误报显著上升。
AI.motivation: Agent技能将自然语言指令转化为动作，使合法自动化与恶意行为高度相似，构成安全挑战。实用筛查器需在捕获几乎所有攻击的同时控制人工审核负担，而现有方法在此平衡上表现不足。
AI.method: 提出SkillScreen：一个紧凑的决策模型，训练目标为直接从SKILL.md文本中评分技能恶意性，仅需单次前向传播即可完成判定。在MaliciousSkillBench上与词级分类器、提示式LLM裁判以及全量微调编码器在相同训练协议下进行对比。
AI.result: 在未见攻击族上达到99%召回率时，仅标记20-25%的良性技能，误报明显少于词级分类器和提示式LLM裁判；在相同训练协议下，对未见来源的泛化优于全量微调编码器。但陌生良性来源会显著提高误报率，表明识别新攻击并不等于能可靠筛查新的技能集合。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了任务训练型决策模型在高召回技能筛查中的价值；同时也揭示出跨来源泛化仍是可靠筛查的关键瓶颈。项目主页：https://jerroldh.github.io/SkillScreen-webpage/

title: DT-LoRA: Reaching Beyond the Tangent Space of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning. We investigate this performance gap through a tangent-space lens: factorized updates are confined to the tangent space of the current low-rank factors, leaving gradient components outside this space unexploited. An analysis of ten representative LoRA variants reveals that these residual components account for most of the gradient energy and exhibit strong spectral concentration. Motivated by this finding, we propose Dynamic Tangent LoRA (DT-LoRA), which partitions a fixed rank budget into a stable branch and a dynamic branch to capture the principal residual gradient directions. We show that these directions define the optimal update of a local quadratic model under orthogonal-complement and rank constraints. Matrix-free randomized SVD recovers them without materializing the residual gradient, while controlled write-back preserves accumulated updates and stabilizes training within the allocated rank. DT-LoRA adds no trainable parameters or inference cost over LoRA. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over LoRA and its variants. Moreover, despite being a general-purpose adaptation method, DT-LoRA outperforms task-specific approaches to open-vocabulary domain generalization for semantic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://github.com/Snipine/DT-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文从切空间视角分析LoRA与全量微调的性能差距，指出因子化更新受限于当前低秩因子的切空间，被忽略的残差梯度分量占据大部分梯度能量且具强谱集中性。据此提出DT-LoRA，将固定秩预算拆分为稳定分支与动态分支以捕获主残差梯度方向，在不增加可训练参数与推理开销的前提下，在CV与NLP任务上稳定超越LoRA及其变体，并在开放词汇域泛化的语义分割上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: LoRA常弱于全量微调，其性能差距的成因尚不清晰。作者希望通过切空间视角定位差距来源，说明现有因子化更新因被限制在当前低秩因子的切空间内，导致切空间外的梯度分量未被利用，从而限制了适配能力。
AI.method: 1）对十种代表性LoRA变体进行梯度分析，发现残差（切空间外）分量占大部分梯度能量且呈强谱集中性；2）提出DT-LoRA，将固定秩预算划分为稳定分支与动态分支，动态分支用于捕获主残差梯度方向；3）理论证明这些方向是在正交补与秩约束下局部二次模型的最优更新；4）采用无矩阵随机SVD恢复这些方向，无需显式构造残差梯度；5）引入受控写回机制以保留累积更新并在既定秩内稳定训练。整体不增加可训练参数与推理开销。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉与自然语言处理多类任务上，DT-LoRA相对LoRA及其变体取得一致性提升；作为通用适配方法，其在语义分割的开放词汇域泛化任务上超越任务专用方法，达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 被忽视的切空间外残差梯度是LoRA性能受限的关键因素，充分利用其主方向可在不增加参数与推理成本的情况下显著提升适配效果，表明DT-LoRA是一种高效且通用的参数高效微调方案。

title: Understanding Machine Taste: Aesthetic Agreement Across Foundation Models in K-pop
summary: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste'' using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究以K-pop歌曲与音乐视频为测试平台，将基础模型的美学评价建模为成对排序任务，考察模型间一致性、群体共识与跨模态偏好对齐。结果显示视觉评价比音频评价具有更强的一致性与共识，而跨模态偏好对齐较弱；视觉共识排名与YouTube历史观看数据的相关性为正但随艺人群体而异。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型进入创意产业，理解其美学偏好是实现AI辅助创意决策的重要前提，目前对"机器品味"的系统刻画仍较缺乏。
AI.method: 将美学评价形式化为成对排序（pairwise ranking）问题，以K-pop歌曲和音乐视频为对象，系统检验模型两两间一致性、群体层面共识以及跨模态偏好对齐，并对比视觉与音频两种模态。
AI.result: 视觉评价中模型两两一致性与群体共识均强于音频评价；两模态间偏好对齐较弱。视觉共识排名与真实世界流行度（YouTube历史观看数据）呈正相关，但相关强度在不同艺人群体间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究初步揭示了基础模型的机器美学偏好特征，为未来兼顾创意内容、艺人身份、受众偏好与市场动态的AI辅助创意决策研究奠定基础。

title: Geometric Structure Predicts Per-Example Neighborhood Loss Under PCA Truncation
summary: Dimensionality reduction can preserve the average performance of text embeddings even when a substantial fraction of their dimensions is removed. Aggregate metrics, however, do not reveal whether degradation is distributed uniformly across examples. We study per-example neighborhood stability under PCA truncation across static word embeddings and modern sentence encoders. Per-item neighbor retention varies widely and is predictable from geometric properties of the representation and its alignment with the retained PCA subspace. The fraction of centered-vector energy retained by the truncated subspace is strongest for CBOW and RI, with neighborhood contrast leading on SkipGram and the modern/Matryoshka settings (GTE approximately tied), while local density is associated with retention in marginal analysis but adds little unique information once energy and contrast are controlled (R-squared increments 0.001 to 0.010). Local intrinsic dimensionality accounts for more variation than density on modern sentence encoders in pairwise comparison. On SciFact, query density predicts retrieval degradation under aggressive compression; on NFCorpus the primary 32d association does not replicate, and a direct variance-restriction test leaves that null unresolved. Average compression performance conceals systematic per-example variation that geometry makes visible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文本嵌入在PCA降维后"逐样本"邻域稳定性的差异，发现邻居保持率差异很大且可由几何属性预测。
AI.motivation: 降维虽能保持嵌入的平均性能，但聚合指标掩盖了退化是否在所有样本上均匀分布，因此需从逐样本角度考察降维的影响。
AI.method: 对静态词嵌入与现代句编码器施加PCA截断，逐样本测量邻居保持率，并分析其与几何属性（中心向量能量保持比例、邻域对比度、局部密度、局部内在维度）的关系；在SciFact与NFCorpus上进行检索退化检验，并做方差限制检验。
AI.result: 逐项邻居保持率差异很大，且可由几何属性预测。能量保持比例对CBOW与RI最强，邻域对比度在SkipGram及现代/Matryoshka设置中领先（GTE大致相当）；局部密度在边际分析中与保持率相关，但在控制能量与对比度后增量极小（R²增量为0.001–0.010）。在现代句编码器的成对比较中，局部内在维度比密度解释更多变异。SciFact上查询密度可预测激进压缩下的检索退化；NFCorpus上32d的主要关联未能复现，方差限制检验未能解决该零结果。
AI.conclusion: 平均压缩性能掩盖了系统性的逐样本差异，而几何属性使这些差异变得可见；不同嵌入类型主导的预测因子不同，密度在控制其他几何量后信息冗余。

title: AttenIR: Aligning Dense Visual Attention with Mesh Warping for Unsupervised Image Retargeting
summary: Image retargeting aims to resize images while preserving salient content free from distortion and stretching. Recent learning-based solutions reduce reliance on traditional hand-crafted features and optimization procedures, leading to more efficient and generalizable performance. Nevertheless, existing approaches still struggle to preserve global structure and content fidelity. To address these limitations, we propose AttenIR, an unsupervised image retargeting framework requiring no manual labels, based on content-aware mesh warping, which ef- fectively couples dense visual attention with sparse mesh constraints. We for- mulate the mesh deformation as a vertex displacement regression task. Guided by saliency priors, our method jointly optimizes scale, structure, and geometry preservation losses. By combining dense visual attention with semantic features, it achieves robust, unsupervised retargeting without manual annotations. Our primary contributions include (1) a lightweight unsupervised method for image retargeting that ensures content fidelity and preserves global structure, and (2) a coarse-to-fine projection strategy to align dense visual attention priors with sparse mesh constraints, enabling content-aware deformation at the pixel level. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive and superior performance compared with both traditional and state-of-the-art learning-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督图像重定向框架AttenIR，基于内容感知的网格形变，耦合稠密视觉注意力与稀疏网格约束，在保持内容保真度和全局结构上取得竞争性甚至更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的图像重定向方法虽减少了对传统手工特征和优化流程的依赖，但在保持全局结构与内容保真度方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 将网格形变建模为顶点位移回归任务；在显著性先验引导下联合优化尺度、结构与几何保持损失；结合稠密视觉注意力与语义特征，实现无需人工标注的无监督重定向；并采用由粗到细的投影策略，将稠密视觉注意力先验与稀疏网格约束对齐，实现像素级内容感知形变。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法相比传统方法及当前最先进的基于学习的方法均取得了竞争性乃至更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: AttenIR以轻量级无监督方式实现图像重定向，保证内容保真并保持全局结构，验证了稠密注意力与稀疏网格约束耦合的有效性。

title: Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior
summary: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step's reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四种测试（输入限制、线索跟随、残差准确率、聚合）以区分LLM评判者在失败归因中是真正跨步骤核查还是依赖表面线索，并呼吁在开发归因基准时报告这些测试。
AI.motivation: 失败归因基准要求LLM评判者判断是哪一步或哪个agent导致了失败，高分本应意味着评判者将故障步骤与整条运行轨迹进行了跨步骤核查。然而，能预测标注的表面线索（虚假信号）也能产生高分，因此需要方法将"真正核查"与"利用线索"区分开来。
AI.method: 作者设计四项测试：1）输入限制：检验部分输入是否即可预测标注；2）线索跟随：检验移动线索后答案是否改变；3）残差准确率：仅在纯线索预测器失败处评估评判者；4）聚合：检验失败组合或指标变化是否改变排名。这些测试由真实观察驱动。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，简单预测器可达到或超过GPT-4.1。在Who&When Pro的两个系统中，仅读取单步推理的分类器即可找出95-100%的故障步骤；其中一个系统在错误注入后故障步骤之后无推理，基于其标签微调的评判者比GPT-4.1高41分；在该步之后添加任务相关推理后，微调评判者下降31-99分，而零样本评判者最多仅下降9分。在Aegis上，将所有agent均判为有责在micro-F1上与GPT-4.1持平，但在精确集合准确率上落后19分。
AI.conclusion: 表面线索可显著影响失败归因基准评分，高分未必代表真实核查。建议在开发失败归因基准时报告这四项测试，以揭示评判者是否真正进行跨步骤核查。

title: Connecting the Dots: Enduring Performance Gaps in ASR Systems Between Standard and Minority English Varieties
comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. 11 pages including appendix, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/smfsamir/longitudinal-asr-eval
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system evaluations have consistently revealed performance disparities along lines of race, gender, socioeconomic status, and language variety. While these disparities are well-documented, they are often (implicitly or explicitly) treated as issues that subsequent, larger, and more universal models will correct. We challenge this assumption of steady progress in reducing accent-related performance disparities, conducting a longitudinal evaluation of 16 prominent systems released between 2021-2025 across 8 datasets representing diverse English accent varieties. We find that the performance disparity between Mainstream US English (MUSE) and minority accents is stubborn, not reliably declining as a function of time. Specifically, while systems are reliably performant on MUSE, minority accents are subject to risks of large performance degradations between generations of systems, sometimes worsening by 65% absolute Word Error Rate. We argue that standard ASR benchmarks enact an implicit language policy privileging Mainstream US English varieties. As such, these performance disparities reflect systemic failures of language technology development infrastructure that disproportionately affect underrepresented speaker populations.

AI.tldr: 对2021—2025年间发布的16个主流ASR系统在8个英语口音数据集上进行纵向评测，发现主流美式英语（MUSE）与少数群体口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，并未随时间可靠缩小，且少数口音在系统代际更替中可能出现急剧退化（绝对词错误率最高恶化65%）。
AI.motivation: ASR评测长期显示存在基于种族、性别、社会经济地位和语言变体的性能差异，但这类差异常被隐含或显式地视为"更大、更通用的模型自然会解决"的问题。本文质疑"性能差异会稳步缩小"这一假设，旨在检验口音相关差异是否随时间改善。
AI.method: 纵向评测：选取2021—2025年间发布的16个知名ASR系统，在覆盖多种英语口音变体的8个数据集上开展跨代际对比评测，重点比较MUSE与少数群体口音之间的性能差距及其随时间的变化趋势。
AI.result: MUSE与少数群体口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，并未随发布时间可靠下降。系统在MUSE上表现稳定良好，但少数口音在系统代际之间面临大幅退化风险，绝对词错误率有时恶化达65%。
AI.conclusion: 标准ASR基准实际上实施了一种隐含的语言政策，赋予主流美式英语变体以特权。这些性能差异反映出语言技术开发基础设施的系统性缺陷，对代表性不足的说话人群体造成不成比例的负面影响。

title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Asia-Pacific Solar Research Conference (APSRC 2026), Canberra, Australia, 1-3 December 2026
summary: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tricorder系统，融合LiDAR-惯性SLAM、几何标定的RGB与热成像及机器学习检测/分割，实现对光伏阵列板下资产的三维视觉-热成像自动化巡检。
AI.motivation: 现有公用事业规模光伏巡检以航拍为主，擅长识别组件级热斑，但对阵列板下关键部件（连接器、线缆、紧固件、结构件）可见性差；这些资产难以规模化一致巡检，其缺陷空间尺度小、易被遮挡且难以从孤立图像中定位。
AI.method: 方法将LiDAR-惯性同时定位与建图（SLAM）与几何标定的RGB、热成像相机及基于机器学习的物体检测与分割相结合；将检测到的资产与重建的三维环境关联，从而对多视角的视觉与热观测进行空间融合与定位。
AI.result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证了MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及螺栓、螺母和扭矩管等结构部件的检测。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了从图像巡检迈向空间落地的自主巡检路径：缺陷可被检测并关联到具体资产及其在光伏电站中的三维位置。

title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.

AI.tldr: RPO（根令牌策略优化）仅训练推理起点令牌（如是否触发 <think> 标签），借助组相对奖励与组内优势实现自适应推理，训练开销与显存占用大幅降低，约用先前方法 2% 的训练算力即学到难度感知的自适应思考。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过显式推理轨迹提升性能，但存在"过度思考"问题：对不同难度查询施加统一的重度计算。闭源模型靠不透明的路由缓解，而开源 LRMs 缺乏内化自适应推理的高效机制，原因是训练成本高昂且训练配方披露有限。
AI.method: 提出 RPO（Root-token Policy Optimization）框架。核心是仅训练初始根令牌（即是否调用 <think> 标签）来自我决定何时推理；采用组相对奖励（group relative reward）与组内优势（group-wise advantages）进行优化。通过聚焦这一关键分支点，显著降低训练开销与显存占用。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族与不同规模上，RPO 均能学到难度感知的自适应思考，且仅需约 2% 于先前自适应推理方法的训练算力。
AI.conclusion: 通过在根令牌这一枢轴分支点上进行策略优化，RPO 为开源 LRMs 提供了低成本、高效的自适应推理内化方案，缓解过度思考问题。

title: More Reader Data or a Better Teacher? Updating a Model of Crowd Highlights in Late 2026
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure. Ancillary files include the pre-registration with its amendments, the results write-up, the aggregate artifacts every reported number is generated from, and the prompt, scoring, target and contrast code
summary: A model trained on readers' highlights can show a newcomer where earlier readers converged on a page, even on pages with few readers. A year of stronger language models suggests two upgrades: use them directly, or use them as teachers. We compare both with a third, more reader data, on one social highlighting platform, with the comparisons, the selection rules and a sealed set of fresh pages fixed in advance. On 215 development pages, seven language models released by October 2026 rank sentences zero-shot at an average precision of at most 0.3744 against the sentences half the readers marked most, and 0.3931 when fused with reading position, while a 3-billion-parameter model trained on reader highlights alone reaches 0.4346. Used as the teacher that breaks ties among readers' counts, the stronger fusion changes a trained model by +0.0013 [-0.0012, +0.0040], whereas going from half to all of its training pages adds +0.0242 [+0.0179, +0.0301]. A 27-billion-parameter backbone on the reader-only recipe adds +0.0225 on the development pages; on 131 fresh pages, read once and too few for a confirmatory comparison, its difference from the 3-billion model is unresolved, both score above the fusion, and in an exploratory split their lead over the previous model sits on pages from domains that their fresh training pages also cover. In this recipe, more reader data improves a trained model where a stronger tie-breaking teacher yields no material gain, and frontier models used as rankers still trail a small model trained on readers.

AI.tldr: 在社交标注平台上比较三种"句子排序"升级路径：直接用强语言模型、用强模型做教师、以及增加读者数据。结果表明更多读者数据能提升小型模型，而强模型作为教师无实质增益，前沿模型直接排序仍不及小模型。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，在读者高亮数据上训练的模型可以预测早期读者在页面上的共识位置，但在读者稀少的页面上效果受限。随着语言模型能力增强，存在两条潜在升级路径：直接使用更强的语言模型，或将其作为教师模型；同时还有第三条路径——增加读者数据。本文旨在系统比较这三条路径，判断哪条能真正提升预测效果。
AI.method: 在一个社交高亮平台上进行受控比较，预先固定比较方案、选择规则和密封的新页面集合。在215个开发页面上，评估截至2026年10月发布的七个语言模型，零样本对句子排序，并与读者标注（半数读者标记最多的句子）作为基准比较；同时测试与阅读位置融合的效果。以30亿参数模型仅用读者高亮训练作为对照。教师模型用于打破读者计数平局，比较融合提升；并对比训练页面从一半增加到全部的效果，以及270亿参数骨干在纯读者配方下的表现，最后在131个新页面上进行探索性验证。
AI.result: 七个语言模型零样本排序的平均精度最高仅0.3744，与阅读位置融合后为0.3931；而30亿参数仅用读者高亮训练的模型达到0.4346。作为打破平局的教师，更强融合仅使训练模型变化+0.0013 [-0.0012, +0.0040]；而训练页面从一半增加到全部则增加+0.0242 [+0.0179, +0.0301]。270亿参数骨干在纯读者配方下于开发页面增加+0.0225；在131个新页面上，其与30亿模型的差异未确定，两者均高于融合模型，且在探索性划分中，其对前代模型的领先集中在与新鲜训练页面覆盖相同领域的页面上。
AI.conclusion: 在该配方中，增加读者数据能有效提升训练模型，而更强的打破平局教师无实质增益；作为排序器，前沿语言模型仍不及在读者数据上训练的小模型。未来提升读者共识预测的方向应优先考虑数据规模而非模型规模或教师蒸馏。

title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
summary: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReMaRk，主张强化学习应针对"请求"而非"单条回复"进行训练：对生成列表一次性使用所有回复标题的并集打分，并对每个请求等概率采样，从而降低训练成本并提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进方法 Rank-GRPO 每个训练样本只选取一条回复，导致优势值主要反映"抽到了哪条回复"（占其方差的 85%），而非生成列表的真实质量。因此，在多条有效人类回复并存的场景下，如何正确地对生成列表进行奖励信号分配成为关键问题。
AI.method: ReMaRk 改变训练单元：以请求为单位而非以回复为单位。它对每条生成的列表一次性与所有回复标题的并集进行评分，并对每个请求等概率采样，避免因回复条数不同带来的采样偏差。
AI.result: 在 7 个骨干模型和 3 个数据集上，ReMaRk 用 25%–53% 的步数即达到 Rank-GRPO 训练 2000 步的验证召回率，并在该预算下领先；训练至不再提升时，从未显著落后于 Rank-GRPO，且在 7 对中有 4 对以更少 GPU 小时达到其最佳性能。该方法在 ProtoQA（约 100 人对每题作答）上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 当存在多条有效人类答案时，应将其联合奖励，即对"请求"而非"单条回复"进行强化学习训练，这一简单原则既降低成本又保持或提升性能。

title: Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
summary: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出既有高阶心智理论（ToM）评测将"信念嵌套深度"等同于"推理阶数"，导致名义上的高阶问题可用低阶捷径作答，存在普遍的阶数虚高；为此形式化"有效阶数"概念，提出经认证的全阶问题集HopToM，并提出推理时方法HopTrace以提升嵌套视角推理能力。
AI.motivation: 心智理论（ToM）是理解他人心理状态并支撑沟通与协作的核心能力，其高阶形式支持策略互动中对嵌套视角的推理。但现有评测常把信念嵌套深度与推理阶数混为一谈，使标称高阶的问题存在低阶捷径，虚高了模型的实际推理阶数，因而需要更严谨的评测与改进手段。
AI.method: 作者通过"支撑连续信念前缀的不同事件"来形式化"有效阶数"，揭示现有基准中普遍存在的阶数虚高现象；据此构建HopToM，包含经认证的全阶问题及对低阶替代方案的对照控制。此外提出HopTrace：一种即插即用的推理时方法，将每次交互一次性编码为视角记录，并以确定性方式解析嵌套查询。
AI.result: 直接提示下，四个前沿LLM的平均准确率从一阶的73.5%降至四阶的20.0%，人类被试同样表现困难。因果干预表明，一类反复出现的错误与较浅信念前缀的证据相关。在认证叙事问题上，HopTrace相较强提示基线将四阶、五阶准确率分别提升22.0与38.5个百分点，且所用token数比多次调用方法少20-39倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究厘清了高阶ToM的评测方式，并提供了提升交互式智能体视角推理的实用途径。

title: GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria
comment: 23 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GENDIS数据集，包含来自印度、肯尼亚和尼日利亚的9600条多语言、人工标注的YouTube评论，采用两级框架区分"是否涉及性别"与"性别内容的评价倾向（负面/正面/中性）"，以在不依赖伤害性判定的前提下估计性别相关话语的流行度并刻画其评价范围。
AI.motivation: 现有性别相关在线内容研究多采用以伤害为中心的任务，将无害的性别内容与非性别内容混为一谈，无法独立估计性别相关话语的基准比例；同时现有数据集集中于高资源语言和全球北方语境，缺乏全球南方多语言场景的资源。
AI.method: 构建GENDIS数据集：采集印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚三国各3200条（共9600条）多语言YouTube评论并进行人工标注；采用两级标注框架，先判定评论是否涉及性别，再将性别相关内容分类为负面、正面或中性；并使用轻监督分类器与前沿零样本大语言模型及通用毒性检测进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在均匀随机分层中，23.8%–35.0%的评论涉及性别；在立场明确的性别相关评论中，82%为中性或正面。各模型上，性别指涉检测显著易于立场分类，正面与中性言论尤为困难。轻监督分类器以显著更低成本达到前沿零样本大语言模型水平，并优于通用毒性检测；跨国家迁移效果仍然有限。
AI.conclusion: GENDIS为测量性别何时被在线提及以及该指涉如何被框定提供了本地化、有据可依的资源，其两级框架为独立于伤害判定的性别话语流行度估计与评价范围刻画奠定了基础。

title: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
summary: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

AI.tldr: Diffuplex 提出一种基于离散扩散的全双工语音语言模型，通过将"何时说"与"说什么"在训练层面解耦，实现语言智能与响应效率的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音模型将"何时说"（交互时机）与"说什么"（内容生成）压缩到单一自回归时间轴中，导致语义计算受感知音频帧率约束，难以同时提升智能水平与响应速度。作者希望打破二者的耦合，实现智能与效率的同步改善。
AI.method: 提出 Diffuplex，基于离散扩散的全双工语音语言模型。训练层面将"何时说"与"说什么"分离；推理时通过自回归（AR）交互策略持续跟踪用户语音，同时以并行扩散方式独立生成并精炼回复内容。由此语义计算不再受感知音频帧率限制。
AI.result: 开启思考模式时，Diffuplex 每次前向传播输出 13.0 个 token，平均达每秒 1872 token，解码速度显著超越前沿自回归模型；不开启思考时，其首音频延迟与现有全双工模型持平，同时语言智能明显更强。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了语音智能体的新范式：在维持实时对话的同时，将并行计算用于智能回复生成，使智能与响应性可同时提升。训练代码与检查点即将公开。

title: Where Words Begin and End
summary: Forced aligners locate each word of a known transcript in the audio, and many speech pipelines depend on them. In our own data, a widely used CTC aligner inserts a pause at nearly every word boundary, and we found almost no aligner evaluated on telephone audio. We compare nine aligner configurations against human word boundaries on read, conversational and telephone English. The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) is the most precise, while CTC aligners consistently start words late, because most frames inside a word go to the blank token. We then fine-tune Whisper with LoRA to predict each word's start and end as timestamp tokens, training only on boundaries placed by people: 47 hours in 87 languages. The resulting aligner is more precise than MFA on every English test condition, and than MFA's own Korean and Dutch models. With FA-Bench's protocol and code on TIMIT, its word-boundary error is 11.6 ms, against 18.2 ms for the best published system. Two choices matter most on telephone conversations: placing the timestamp slots after the word they time, and training on noisy transcripts, which also makes the aligner nearly insensitive to errors in the transcript. The released model reaches 16.0 ms on real landline calls, against 36.5 ms for MFA. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了九种强制对齐器在朗读、会话及电话英语上的表现，发现CTC类对齐器系统性地将词起始预测偏晚，而MFA最精确；作者随后用LoRA微调Whisper，以时间戳token直接预测词边界（基于87种语言、47小时人工边界数据），在全部英语测试条件下超越MFA，并在TIMIT上将词边界误差降至11.6 ms。
AI.motivation: 强制对齐器为已知转写文本在音频中定位每个词，是众多语音流水线的关键组件。作者在实际数据中发现，广泛使用的CTC对齐器几乎在每个词边界处插入停顿，且几乎没有对齐器在电话音频上被评测过，因此亟需在多种英语条件下（尤其电话对话）系统比较并对齐精度进行改进。
AI.method: 首先以人工词边界为参考，对九种对齐器配置在朗读、会话和电话英语上进行对比评测。随后采用LoRA对Whisper进行微调，将每个词的起始与结束作为时间戳token进行预测，仅使用人工标注的边界数据训练（87种语言、47小时）。重点探究两个设计选择：时间戳槽位置于其所计时的词之后，以及在噪声转写上训练。
AI.result: MFA最精确，CTC对齐器因词内多数帧被归入blank token而系统性偏晚。微调后的对齐器在所有英语测试条件上均优于MFA，也优于MFA自身的韩语与荷兰语模型。在FA-Bench协议下于TIMIT上，词边界误差为11.6 ms，而此前最佳公开系统为18.2 ms。在电话对话中，时间戳槽位后置与噪声转写训练最为关键，后者还使对齐器对转写错误近乎不敏感。真实固话通话上达到16.0 ms，而MFA为36.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 基于人工边界的Whisper-LoRA时间戳对齐方案显著优于传统MFA与CTC对齐器，尤其在电话等困难条件下表现突出，并对转写噪声具有鲁棒性；模型已开源发布于Hugging Face。

title: DexStitch: Learning and Composing Dexterous Skills from Human Videos via Contact-Aware Robotic Inpainting
summary: A long-horizon manipulation task consists of primitive skills and the transitions connecting them. Learning skills that can be executed in sequence requires supervision for both, which is costly to collect on a robot. Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations, but transferring them to robots requires extracting robot-compatible observations and actions together with their skill structure. We present DexStitch, a framework that cuts long-horizon human videos into skills and transitions, converts them into aligned robot observation-action-skill data, and stitches the learned skills into a requested sequence. A skill classifier first segments the videos into manipulation skills and transitions. DexStitch then converts the human demonstrations into robot observations and actions while retaining their corresponding skill labels. During conversion, per-finger human-object contacts guide dexterous hand retargeting and robotic inpainting, preserving contact geometry and finger-object occlusion ordering. To stitch the learned skills into a sequence, a shared skill-conditioned policy is pretrained on the resulting synthetic data and finetuned on a mixture of synthetic data and a small set of single-skill teleoperation episodes. Conditioning on the current and next skills guides each transition toward the following skill, while predicted skill progression enables closed-loop switching. On a held-out session, the classifier agrees with manual annotations on 92.4% of frames. Across four household skills, DexStitch achieves 80.0% single-skill success and 77.5% sequence success.

AI.tldr: DexStitch 从长时程人类视频中切分技能与过渡，转换为机器人观测-动作-技能对齐数据，并拼接学习到的技能以完成指定序列。
AI.motivation: 长时程操作任务需要为技能及技能间过渡同时提供监督，而机器人上采集此类监督成本高昂；人类视频虽可规模化获取，但迁移到机器人需同时提取机器人可用的观测、动作及技能结构。
AI.method: 先用技能分类器将视频分割为操作技能与过渡；转换时利用逐指人-物接触指导灵巧手重定向与机器人修补，保持接触几何与手指-物体遮挡顺序；再用共享技能条件策略在合成数据上预训练，并在合成数据与少量单技能遥操作片段混合数据上微调，以当前与下一技能为条件引导过渡，并通过预测技能进展实现闭环切换。
AI.result: 在留出会话上，分类器与人工标注在 92.4% 的帧上一致；在四个家庭技能上，单技能成功率 80.0%，序列成功率 77.5%。
AI.conclusion: DexStitch 表明可从长时程人类视频中提取技能结构并对齐机器人数据，从而以少量遥操作数据实现灵巧长时程技能的序列化执行。

title: When, Where, and Why: Hierarchical Causal Explainability for Video Face Understanding with MLLMs
summary: Understanding facial behaviour in video requires answering three fundamental questions: when a key facial expression occurs, where the model attends on the face at that moment, and why that evidence is necessary rather than merely correlated. Today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can label and describe video, but they rarely provide faithful explanations, especially for small facial movements that change over time. We present VideoFace-X-LLM, a framework for explainable facial video understanding comprising two key components. First, we introduce ExplainFace, a weakly supervised video-text corpus for facial behaviour understanding, automatically constructed from CelebV-HQ videos and validated through human evaluation and a two-model audit (at most 2.3% contradictions), demonstrating consistent gains across two backbone architectures. Second, H-TCC (Hierarchical Temporal Spatial Causal Concepts), which finds the key temporal moments (When), the facial regions (Where), and verifies its causal necessity (Why) through targeted occlusion. Fine-tuning on ExplainFace raises appearance Macro F1 from 19.48% to 32.87% (+13.39), with gains of +4.38 on actions, +6.77 on temporal emotion, and +11.84 F1 on deepfake detection. We also measure the explanations pointing lift, face/edge lift, stability, an Adebayo sanity check, and a necessity test rather than only showing examples. Our models, code, and corpus are available on request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VideoFace-X-LLM 可解释人脸视频理解框架，包含 ExplainFace 弱监督视频-文本语料与 H-TCC 分层时序空间因果概念方法，回答表情的"何时、何处、为何"。
AI.motivation: 视频人脸行为理解需回答三个根本问题：关键面部表情何时发生、模型注意力落在面部何处、以及为何该证据是必要的而非仅相关；现有多模态大模型（MLLM）虽能标注和描述视频，但极少提供忠实解释，尤其对随时间变化的小幅面部动作。
AI.method: 框架含两部分：1) ExplainFace，从 CelebV-HQ 视频自动构建的弱监督视频-文本语料，经人工评估与双模型审计（矛盾率至多 2.3%）验证；2) H-TCC（Hierarchical Temporal Spatial Causal Concepts），定位关键时间时刻（When）、面部区域（Where），并通过定向遮挡验证因果必要性（Why）。
AI.result: 在 ExplainFace 上微调使 appearance Macro F1 从 19.48% 升至 32.87%（+13.39），action +4.38、temporal emotion +6.77、deepfake 检测 F1 +11.84；解释质量以 pointing lift、face/edge lift、稳定性、Adebayo sanity check 与必要性测试量化评估。ExplainFace 在两种骨干架构上均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过弱监督语料与因果概念方法，提升了人脸视频理解性能并提供可量化的忠实解释，模型、代码与语料可在研究用途下索取。

title: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
summary: GUI grounding enables web agents to translate natural-language instructions into actionable interface locations. However, dense layouts and small, visually similar controls can lead models toward plausible but incorrect elements, while refinement around a single prediction may leave alternative targets unexplored. We propose the Multi-Hypothesis Verification Framework (MHVF) for training-free GUI grounding. It combines multi-hypothesis exploration with local visual verification using a single pretrained vision-language model. To explore alternative targets, MHVF constructs spatial hypotheses from multiple full-screen predictions and examines the corresponding regions through zoomed re-localization. To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views. Verification scores then guide a second round of local search and rank candidates retained from both search levels for final selection. Experiments with five general-purpose and GUI-specific models across eight benchmark settings demonstrate improvements in grounding accuracy in most settings. MHVF improves UI-Venus-Ground-7B by 4.3 and 2.1 percentage points on Mind2Web and VisualWebBench, respectively, and raises Qwen2.5-VL-7B's accuracy on ScreenSpot-Pro from 23.6% to 53.6%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出免训练的多假设验证框架MHVF，通过多假设探索与局部视觉验证提升GUI grounding精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding需将自然语言指令映射到界面可操作位置，但密集布局及视觉相似的小控件易使模型选中貌似合理却错误的元素；围绕单一预测做细化可能遗漏其他候选目标。
AI.method: MHVF为免训练框架，用单一预训练视觉语言模型：1）从多个全屏预测构建空间假设，通过放大重定位考察相应区域；2）用带标记局部视图验证候选与指令的一致性以消歧；3）验证分数引导第二轮局部搜索，并对两级搜索保留的候选排序后最终选择。
AI.result: 在8个基准设置、5个通用及GUI专用模型上，多数设置grounding精度提升。UI-Venus-Ground-7B在Mind2Web和VisualWebBench上分别提升4.3和2.1个百分点；Qwen2.5-VL-7B在ScreenSpot-Pro上从23.6%提升至53.6%。
AI.conclusion: MHVF通过多假设探索加局部视觉验证，在免训练条件下有效缓解密集布局与相似控件导致的误定位，显著提升多种模型的GUI grounding准确率。

title: Multimodal Fusion of RGB and Complementary Modalities for Semantic Segmentation
comment: This work is submitted to the IJCV journal
summary: Multi-modal semantic segmentation adds an auxiliary sensing stream to RGB images (RGB-X), such as thermal, LiDAR, depth, event, polarization, or light field. This can improve robustness in poor lighting and under motion blur. But different sensors often produce features that do not match well, and fusion can become unstable. To alleviate these issues, we propose a bidirectional polarity-aware cross-modality fusion (BPCF) module that effectively captures complementary cues while enhancing feature alignment. We evaluate the framework on six modality pairings: RGB-Thermal, RGB-LiDAR, RGB-Depth, RGB-Event, RGB-Polarization, and RGB-Light Field. Our model achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on eight public datasets, including MFNet, KITTI-360, DELIVER, DDD17, DSEC, MCubeS, ZJU, and UrbanLF. The codes and trained models will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出双向极性感知跨模态融合（BPCF）模块，用于RGB-X多模态语义分割，缓解不同传感器特征不匹配与融合不稳定问题，在六种模态组合、八个公开数据集上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 多模态语义分割通过为RGB图像引入辅助感知流（如热成像、LiDAR、深度、事件、偏振或光场），可提升弱光与运动模糊场景下的鲁棒性。但不同传感器产生的特征往往难以良好匹配，导致融合过程不稳定，因此需要一种能有效捕捉互补线索并增强特征对齐的融合方法。
AI.method: 提出双向极性感知跨模态融合（BPCF）模块，在融合过程中捕捉互补线索并增强特征对齐。评估覆盖六种模态配对：RGB-热成像、RGB-LiDAR、RGB-深度、RGB-事件、RGB-偏振、RGB-光场。
AI.result: 在八个公开数据集（MFNet、KITTI-360、DELIVER、DDD17、DSEC、MCubeS、ZJU、UrbanLF）上取得SOTA结果。代码与训练模型将在录用后开源。
AI.conclusion: BPCF模块有效提升多模态特征对齐与融合稳定性，在多种模态组合与数据集上验证了通用性与先进性。

title: Beyond the End-Effector: Learning Whole-Arm Contact Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 23 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://wacl-robot.github.io
summary: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector's task. The robot's kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer's input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出分层框架WACL，用三种机器人无关表示描述整臂接触任务，交由准静态表面接触优化器落地到具体机械臂，仅需10个裸手演示即可学习接触轨迹，并能在末端执行器新约束下无需重训而泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人操作依赖末端执行器为中心的交互，而人类常利用整臂接触提升效率、鲁棒性与适应性（手被占用或无需精确抓取时）。让机器人具备类似能力面临三大挑战：需选择手臂上接触位置、生成有效的非抓取式交互、同时满足末端执行器特定的位姿或安全约束。
AI.method: WACL将每个整臂接触任务用三种机器人无关表示刻画并交给准静态表面接触优化器：（1）概括场景的语义关键点；（2）指定手臂在物体上按压位置与方式的参考接触轨迹；（3）由视觉语言模型从任务描述生成、保护末端执行器任务的安全感知路径约束。机器人运动学链仅进入该优化器，通过联合搜索接触连杆、连杆上的接触点及实现该接触的关节配置，将这些表示落地到机械臂。该分解使WACL可从每任务10个免遥操作的裸手人类演示中学习接触轨迹，且新末端约束只改变优化器输入而不影响任何已训练组件。
AI.result: 在7自由度机械臂上跨四个整臂任务的真机实验表明：在末端执行器约束下，WACL能持续维持接触，而强力的连杆位姿基线失败（成功率78% vs. 33%）；且无需重训即可泛化到新约束。
AI.conclusion: WACL通过机器人无关表示与优化器的分层解耦，实现了高效数据（10个裸手演示）的整臂接触操作学习，并在末端约束变化下展现出优于基线的鲁棒性与免重训泛化能力。

title: BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mender，一个可验证的运行时控制框架，将多智能体协作中的"交接断裂"修复形式化为对显式依赖图的选择性干预，通过故障归因与校准流水线提供监督，实现低开销的任务成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作在长时程复杂任务中至关重要，协调协议虽不断进步，但智能体间协作接口的系统性故障仍是普遍瓶颈。协作流程中常出现"交接断裂"：关键任务上下文被遗漏、错误路由或被忽略，而各智能体输出在局部看却都合理。亟需解决这一接口层面的失效问题。
AI.method: 核心是集成式故障归因与校准流水线（数据集），解耦执行依赖并注入反事实交接扰动，为运行时干预提供经验监督。Mender 动态将可观测交互轨迹编译为溯源图以定位未解决依赖，且无需访问智能体私有状态；随后通过经验门控权衡预期收益与干扰风险来评估候选修复，仅在形式化局部后置条件成立时执行修复。
AI.result: 在多个高要求基准上，Mender 将任务成功率最高提升 12.3 个百分点（SILO-BENCH）和 11.1 个百分点（TeamBench）；在两种骨干模型上保持严格成本效益，边际 token 开销低至 2.0%；在 MAST 基准的 562 条交接相关轨迹上，单次通过即达到 69.8% F1。
AI.conclusion: Mender 为可验证的协调修复建立了可靠的操作边界，证明以选择性干预为核心的交接修复能有效克服多智能体协作接口瓶颈，同时保持低成本。

title: SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis
summary: Pixel-level annotation for chest X-ray (CXR) lesion segmentation is expensive, making active learning (AL) essential. However, existing AL strategies fail to account for the spatial distribution of selected samples, resulting in inconsistent performance across focal (e.g., aortic calcification) and diffuse (e.g., nodules) pathologies. In this paper, we propose SPARCL (Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning) to dynamically balance predictive uncertainty with cumulative spatial coverage. By employing a concave coverage function, SPARCL imposes diminishing returns on previously annotated regions, naturally directing the annotation budget toward under-labeled areas. Furthermore, an entropy gate reverts the algorithm to standard uncertainty sampling when spatial variation is absent. This coverage objective is monotone submodular, guaranteeing near-optimal greedy batch selection. To address how aggregate metrics like Dice obscure regional failures, we further introduce two metrics---Spatial Inconsistency (SI) and Performance Coverage (PC)---to quantify anatomical fairness across AL rounds. Evaluated on an in-house calcification cohort and public CXR benchmarks, SPARCL reaches 95% of fully supervised performance using only 24% of the data, compared to 29% for the best baseline. Ultimately, SPARCL ensures robust spatial reliability, surfacing regional gains that aggregate metrics miss.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARCL主动学习策略，通过空间自适应区域覆盖平衡不确定性与空间覆盖，仅用24%数据即达95%全监督性能，并引入SI与PC两项指标量化解剖公平性。
AI.motivation: 胸片病灶分割的像素级标注成本高昂，主动学习（AL）因此十分必要。然而现有AL策略未考虑所选样本的空间分布，导致在局灶性（如主动脉钙化）与弥漫性（如结节）病理上的表现不一致。此外，Dice等聚合指标会掩盖区域性的分割失败，缺乏对解剖公平性的量化手段。
AI.method: 提出SPARCL（Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning），动态平衡预测不确定性与累积空间覆盖。采用凹形覆盖函数对已标注区域施加递减回报，将标注预算自然导向标注不足区域；并设置熵门控，在空间变化缺失时回退到标准不确定性采样。该覆盖目标是单调子模函数，保证贪心批量选择具近似最优性。另引入空间不一致性（SI）与性能覆盖率（PC）两项指标，量化AL各轮次的解剖公平性。
AI.result: 在内部钙化队列与公开CXR基准上评估，SPARCL仅用24%数据即达到95%的全监督性能，而最优基线需29%数据。SPARCL确保了稳健的空间可靠性，能够揭示聚合指标所遗漏的区域增益。
AI.conclusion: SPARCL通过空间自适应区域覆盖有效解决了现有AL策略忽视空间分布的问题，在显著降低标注成本的同时提升解剖公平性，并提供了揭示区域失败的细粒度评价指标。

title: Perturbation, Not Provenance: Why Activation Steering Does Not Make a Robust Text Watermark
summary: Linear directions in the activation space of large language models causally and universally influence model behavior. This suggests that they might serve as a basis for a robust text watermark. The idea is to steer the generation along a specific semantic direction and then recover the mark by probing the activations of the re-encoded text. We test this hypothesis by conducting a series of experiments. We vary the strength of the steering and use four different directions (formality, sentiment, complexity, and a random control) across two different model families. We also test two paraphrasing attacks: a sentence-level one and a stronger paragraph-level one. The results show that activation-steering watermarks are outperformed by a standard logit-based watermark (KGW) in terms of detection accuracy. At a matched level of fluency (within 1.15 times the original text's perplexity), KGW achieved an AUC of 0.81 against a sentence-level paraphraser, while the best steering direction only reached 0.65. A stronger paragraph-level paraphraser lowered both (0.65 for KGW and 0.59 for steering), narrowing the gap but not reversing it. On Qwen, it left the two indistinguishable but at near-chance levels for both. We further showed that the detectability provided by steering was not semantic: a random direction was just as detectable as a meaningful one. The signal was independent of which layer was probed and whether a surface feature control was used. We conclude that, in this case, semantic activation does not encode a localized, recoverable semantic mark, but rather a global, content-independent shift that can only be strongly detected when the text is degraded.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了“激活空间语义方向可作为鲁棒文本水印”的假设，结果显示激活引导水印在检测准确率上不及标准 KGW 对数几率水印，且其可检测性并非源于语义。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型激活空间中的线性方向能够因果且普遍地影响模型行为，作者据此提出一个设想：若能沿特定语义方向引导生成，再通过探测重新编码文本的激活来恢复标记，或许可以构建一种鲁棒的文本水印。论文旨在验证这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 作者开展了一系列实验：改变引导强度，并使用四种方向（正式度、情感、复杂度以及随机对照）覆盖两个不同的模型家族；同时测试两种改写攻击，即句子级改写和更强的段落级改写；并以标准对数几率水印 KGW 作为对比基线，在流利度匹配（约为原文困惑度的 1.15 倍以内）的条件下比较检测表现；此外还检验了随机方向、不同探测层以及表层特征控制的影响。
AI.result: 激活引导水印的检测准确率低于 KGW。在流利度匹配条件下，面对句子级改写，KGW 的 AUC 为 0.81，而最佳引导方向仅为 0.65；更强的段落级改写使两者分别降至 0.65 和 0.59，差距缩小但未反转；在 Qwen 模型上两者不可区分，但均接近随机水平。进一步实验表明，随机方向与有意义方向同样可被检测，信号与所探测的层以及是否使用表层特征控制无关。
AI.conclusion: 在本研究情形下，语义激活并未编码一种局部化、可恢复的语义标记，而是表现为一种全局的、与内容无关的偏移，只有在文本被退化时才能被强检测到。因此，激活引导难以作为鲁棒的文本水印方案。

title: Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Centric Systems, Services, and Applications (AISSA 2026)
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. False positives that the policy can learn to trigger can cause plateaus or collapse, sometimes even with a low initial error rate. Whether a verifier wrongly rejects or accepts depends on what it checks and who built it, not on its family. Its errors shift as the policy improves, and most mitigations have been tested against only one kind of error. We compile the findings into comparison tables, reconcile apparent conflicts in the literature, and propose a reporting protocol to make future results comparable.

AI.tldr: 本文综述58项研究，系统考察可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中验证器的错误类型、对训练的影响及缓解方法，指出错误结构比错误率更关键，并提出统一报告协议。
AI.motivation: RLVR已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的主流方法，但其核心假设——评分验证器本身正确——在实践中难以成立。规则验证器会误拒格式异常的正确答案，单元测试会接受错误程序，LLM评判器可能被诱导通过空答案或对抗性回答。然而，现有研究对验证器错误的系统认识不足，缺乏对错误类型、训练影响及缓解措施适用性的整合分析，且文献结论存在表面冲突。
AI.method: 对58项测量、分析或缓解验证器错误的研究进行系统性综述。围绕四个核心问题组织分析：（1）验证器会犯哪些错误；（2）这些错误如何影响训练；（3）哪些缓解措施对应哪些错误；（4）结论如何推广到自生成奖励、量规与评判器奖励、无验证器奖励等场景。同时编制对比表、调和文献中的表面冲突，并提出报告协议。
AI.result: 错误的“结构”比其“发生率”更重要。随机错误主要减慢学习速度，但在固定预算或KL正则化下也会降低最终准确率。策略能够学会触发的假阳性（即奖励黑客可利用的错误接受）可导致性能平台期或崩溃，即使初始错误率很低。验证器是错误拒绝还是错误接受，取决于其检查内容和构建者，而非其所属家族（规则/测试/评判器）。验证器错误会随策略改进而漂移，而大多数缓解措施仅针对单一类型错误进行过测试。
AI.conclusion: 验证器错误是RLVR可靠性的关键瓶颈，需从“降低错误率”转向“关注错误结构”。未来研究应区分错误类型与来源，评估缓解措施的跨错误泛化性，并采用统一报告协议以保证结果可比性，同时将分析框架扩展至自生成、量规与评判器及无验证器奖励等更广泛场景。

title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
summary: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QK-Edit，一个无需训练、基于查询-键（Query-Key）注意力操控的框架，用于多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiTs）的精确文本引导图像与视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiTs）凭借多模态自注意力（MM-SA）在统一文本-视觉合成任务中超越了传统U-Net架构。但其将图像与文本token拼接后统一自注意力的机制，使得传统基于U-Net的注意力操控编辑方法失效，编辑能力受限。
AI.method: 提出QK-Edit：一种免训练框架，通过新颖的查询-键（QK）操控策略，隔离并调整关键的注意力分量，从而在提示词保真度与结构一致性之间取得平衡；该方法可在推理阶段通过特征替换轻松实现。
AI.result: QK-Edit支持对象添加、移除、替换，以及背景、材质、颜色更改和风格转换等多种编辑任务，并在FLUX、HunyuanVideo等先进模型上展现出优越的编辑性能。
AI.conclusion: QK-Edit有效弥合了MM-DiTs在生成能力与可编辑灵活性之间的差距，为可扩展的多模态内容创作铺平了道路。

title: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Diff Diffusion，将扩散式推理形式化为结构化编辑操作，用于代码编辑预测，兼顾准确性与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散大语言模型（dLLM）擅长并行生成，但面向序列合成而非编辑预测，与现代 AI 辅助 IDE 的编辑预测场景不匹配；代码编辑通常稀疏且保留大部分原有 token，整体重生成会造成大量计算浪费。
AI.method: 将去噪过程表示为从原始代码片段到修订版本的结构化编辑操作（edit paths），并融合多阶段训练与高效并行解码，使计算集中于被修改区域，支持多位置并行修改与准确的低延迟编辑。
AI.result: 在公开编辑补全基准、编辑预测评测及线上验证中，Diff Diffusion 达到或超越自回归基线；公开编辑补全基准推理速度提升 2.78 倍，生产环境 P50 模型延迟降低 39.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为需要高准确率与低延迟的 AI 应用提供了新的建模视角。

title: FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval
summary: Evaluating fashion retrieval systems remains challenging due to the limited availability of benchmarks that capture the fine-grained, open-ended queries encountered in real-world search and recommendation. Existing benchmarks often rely on manual curation, predefined taxonomies, or synthetic prompts, limiting scalability and semantic coverage. We introduce FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval, an automated framework that derives user-type queries and relevance sets directly from catalog structure. Our key insight is that hierarchical discrete representations learned by Residual Quantized Variational Autoencoders (RQ-VAE) organize products into semantically coherent clusters at progressively finer granularities. We leverage this structure to construct FASHION-RQBENCH, a scalable benchmark without manual query annotation or predefined taxonomies. We propose four complementary tasks for evaluating ranking, relevance classification, fine-grained sibling discrimination, and paraphrase robustness, alongside query- and attribute-level relevance metrics. Experiments across recent retrieval models demonstrate that FASHION-RQBENCH differentiates model capabilities across query types and attributes. A human study further shows that benchmark queries achieve comparable naturalness and higher intent clarity than real user queries, supporting their validity for real-world evaluation. The code and FASHION-RQBENCH dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FASHION-RQ框架，利用RQ-VAE学习的分层离散表征从商品目录结构中自动挖掘用户类型查询与相关性集合，构建无需人工标注和预定义分类体系的规模化基准FASHION-RQBENCH，并设计四项互补任务与查询/属性级指标，实验证明其能区分模型能力，人工研究显示查询自然度与意图清晰度优于真实用户查询。
AI.motivation: 时尚检索评估受限于缺乏能捕捉真实搜索与推荐中细粒度、开放式查询的基准。现有基准依赖人工策划、预定义分类体系或合成提示，限制了可扩展性与语义覆盖范围。
AI.method: 核心洞察是RQ-VAE学习的分层离散表征可将商品组织为逐级更细粒度的语义连贯簇。基于此结构自动推导用户类型查询与相关性集合，构建无需人工查询标注或预定义分类体系的FASHION-RQBENCH基准；设计排序、相关性分类、细粒度同类商品区分、复述鲁棒性四项互补任务，并提出查询级与属性级相关性指标。
AI.result: 在近期多种检索模型上的实验表明，FASHION-RQBENCH能够区分模型在不同查询类型与属性上的能力差异；人工研究显示基准查询的自然度与真实用户查询相当，且意图清晰度更高，支持其用于真实场景评估的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展、自动化且语义覆盖更广的时尚检索评估方案，无需人工标注即可生成有效基准，代码与数据集将在录用后公开。

title: What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?
comment: Extended version of Neurips 2025 paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01946
summary: Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation's 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探究"什么样的视觉表征有利于空间理解"，发现表征自身的3D结构强度与其增益高度相关，且表征形式决定其所需迁移机制，并据此将潜在特征与显式几何蒸馏进单一MLLM，仅用RGB视频输入即在静态3D与动态4D空间推理基准上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）的视觉预训练数据几乎全为2D，其视觉token缺乏内在3D结构信息，难以支撑对3D物理世界的推理。尽管已有大量方法通过迁移外部视觉或几何模型表征来注入3D结构，但"什么样的视觉表征才有利于空间理解"这一关键问题仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 将"迁移什么"与"如何迁移"解耦：迁移内容涵盖3D几何模型、自监督图像/视频模型、视觉语言模型与生成模型，形式为潜在特征或显式深度/点图（point maps）；迁移方式分为蒸馏（作为监督目标）与融合（作为额外输入）。以潜在特征的跨视角一致性、显式几何的深度与重建精度为指标，衡量表征的3D结构强度，并分析其与增益的关系及表征形式对迁移机制的依赖。
AI.result: 表征的3D结构与其带来的增益强相关；表征形式决定所需机制——潜在特征从融合与蒸馏中获益相当，显式几何从融合中获益甚微，其蒸馏增益主要依赖几何解码头（geometry decoding head）。
AI.conclusion: 受上述发现指导，将潜在特征与显式几何同时蒸馏进单一MLLM；该模型仅以RGB视频为输入，在静态3D与动态4D空间推理基准上相较基座模型取得一致提升，验证了"3D结构强度"与"形式—机制匹配"原则的有效性。

title: DVTR-KD: Distilling Vision-Language Models via Intermediate Visual Token Reconstruction
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse vision-language tasks, but their computational demands limit deployment under constrained budgets, particularly on edge devices. Many works focus on Knowledge Distillation (KD) and try to transfer knowledge from powerful teacher models to students. In addition to reducing model size, visual token compression provides a complementary route to efficiency, but introduces mismatched visual token counts that complicate direct token-wise knowledge transfer. To mitigate this, we propose DVTR-KD, a knowledge distillation framework based on \textbf{D}ense \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}oken \textbf{R}econstruction, which reconstructs the teacher's dense visual tokens from the student's compressed tokens. We reconstruct visual states after the final LLM layer and at the input to an intermediate layer identified as important for visual-information readout. At the intermediate layer, reconstruction is supervised through the teacher's response predictions rather than by direct token-wise KL or MSE matching.
