First valuable research has emerged since 30 years ago and the two last decades witnessed very significant publications in this field following the rise of low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods) and deep learning models (data-based methods). Furthermore, several surveys can be found in the literature but none of them addresses an overall review in this field. In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the traditional and recent approaches in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models, i.e mathematical models, machine learning models and signal processing models. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the available resources, datasets and libraries. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research. For the sake of reading, this survey is divided into two parts: 1) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1)" about conventional and low-rank and sparse decomposition (model-based methods), and 2) "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)" about deep learning models (data-based methods).

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇红外小目标检测领域的综述（分两部分）：Part 1覆盖传统方法与低秩稀疏分解（基于模型），Part 2覆盖深度学习（基于数据）。文章按数学、机器学习、信号处理三类模型分类，讨论各方法声称应对的关键场景，梳理数据集与工具库资源，并提出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测在军用与民用（地面、空中、海上监视）中广泛用于检测静止或运动目标。该领域已有近三十年研究，近二十年因低秩稀疏分解（模型驱动）与深度学习（数据驱动）而涌现大量成果，但现有综述均为局部综述，缺乏覆盖全领域的整体性回顾。因此需要一篇系统的完整综述。
AI.method: 综述方法：首先按建模方式将文献中的方法分为数学（模型）方法、机器学习方法与信号处理方法三类；随后按各方法声称能够处理的关键困难场景进行讨论与对比；并整理该领域可用的资源、数据集与代码库；最后给出若干有前景的未来研究方向。文章分两部分：Part 1 聚焦传统方法与低秩稀疏分解（基于模型的方法），Part 2 聚焦深度学习模型（基于数据的方法）。
AI.result: 本文提供了红外小目标检测领域从传统到近期方法的完整综述（分两部分呈现）。其成果为：建立了以数学、机器学习、信号处理为纲的方法分类体系，按关键处理场景对方法进行讨论，汇总了数据集与工具库等资源，并提炼出未来研究的若干方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述以建模范式为主线统一梳理了红外小目标检测的传统与近期方法，弥补了此前缺乏整体性综述的空白；两部分分别覆盖基于模型的低秩稀疏分解与基于数据的深度学习，为研究者提供分类框架、资源索引与研究路线图。

title: Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation
summary: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PixText，将局部文本精修建模为像素空间的分组图像生成，仅生成目标区域以保留未编辑内容，并用 MeanFlow 实现四步生成；同时构建 Text Refinement Bench 基准，PixText 在字形通过率和目标字符 OCR 准确率上大幅超越最强基线，且生成成本低于每图一个 GPU 秒。
AI.motivation: 生成图像整体布局和视觉内容通常较为连贯，但小文本和复杂字符存在局部错误，限制了可读性与实用性。场景文本精修需要兼顾准确性、内容保留与效率。现有基于 VAE 的方法在重建时易丢失细小笔画，而全图编辑可能改变背景颜色。
AI.method: 将局部文本精修形式化为像素空间中的分组图像生成。以原始图像为条件，PixText 仅生成目标区域，从而保留未编辑内容，并采用 MeanFlow 实现四步生成。此外构建 Text Refinement Bench，用于评估生成图像中的文本纠正效果与图像保留程度。
AI.result: 在该基准上，PixText 达到 83.06% 的字形通过率和 94.66% 的目标字符精确 OCR 准确率，而最强基线分别为 36.77% 和 52.31%。其四步 MeanFlow 变体在保持 81.84% 通过率的同时，每张图像摊销生成成本低于一个 GPU 秒。
AI.conclusion: PixText 通过在像素空间进行局部条件生成并结合 MeanFlow 快速采样，有效解决了现有方法在笔画保真与背景保持上的不足，在文本精修准确性与效率上显著优于基线，并配套提出 Text Refinement Bench 以规范化该任务的评测。

title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LongForcing蒸馏方法，通过对齐长时程学生自回归轨迹与扩展时域双向教师，解决视频扩散模型长时程生成中的渐进漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在超出训练窗口的长时程展开中会出现渐进漂移：画质退化、运动不一致、物体身份逐渐崩塌。作者将其归因于"监督时域差距"——短时程蒸馏使后期 rollout 状态缺乏直接监督；且匹配短窗口边缘分布并不能决定长时程行为，而只有更长的 on-policy 轨迹才能暴露延迟失效。
AI.method: 提出 LongForcing 蒸馏方法：保留短时程 teacher-forcing 与因果 ODE 蒸馏阶段，在最后的分布匹配阶段用扩展时域的双向教师替换 realscore 教师，对延长的学生自回归 rollout 施加标准分布匹配监督，不改变学生架构、不增加推理开销。核心思想是规模化地做时序流形匹配。
AI.result: 在文本到视频生成上 VBench Quality 达 85.52；在交互式动作条件世界模型上，第一人称消融实验将 WorldRoamBench 60s 动作分数提升 23.9 分；定性压力测试采样出长达 24 小时的交互 rollout，远超训练时域。
AI.conclusion: 沿时间轴扩展监督是迈向长时程世界模型的可行且实用的步骤，LongForcing 有效缓解长时程漂移并大幅提升超长展开的稳定性。

title: Unsupervised and Supervised Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 2)
summary: Since the rise of supervised deep learning modelet dets, researchers has attempt to solve infrared small targection using various models like conventional neural networks, GANS, Transformers, Mixture of Experts and recent graph/hypergraph neural networks. Moreover, these deep neural networks methods surpassed the traditional unsupervised models and the low-rank and sparse decomposition unsupervised models reviewed in "Traditional and Recent Approaches for Infrared Small Target Detection : Overview, Challenges and Perspectives (Part 1). In this context, the aim of this paper is to provide a complete survey of the deep learning models in infrared small target detection. First, we categorize the different approaches found in the literature in terms of the modeling models of strategies. Then, we have discussed them in terms of the critical situations that they claim to handle. Furthermore, we present the specific performance evaluation. Then, we conclude with several promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于红外小目标检测中深度学习模型的综述，对文献方法按建模策略分类，讨论其应对的关键场景与性能评估，并展望未来方向。
AI.motivation: 自监督深度学习模型兴起以来，研究者尝试用卷积网络、GAN、Transformer、混合专家及图/超图神经网络等多种模型解决红外小目标检测问题，且这些深度方法已超越传统无监督方法以及Part 1综述的低秩稀疏分解无监督模型。因此有必要对深度学习模型在该任务中的应用进行完整综述。
AI.method: 综述性研究：首先按文献中方法的建模策略进行分类；随后针对各方法声称能够处理的关键（critical）场景进行讨论；并介绍具体的性能评估方式。
AI.result: 对红外小目标检测的深度学习模型进行了系统梳理与分类，归纳了各方法所针对的关键场景，并总结了相应的性能评估指标与方法。
AI.conclusion: 给出若干有前景的未来研究方向，作为该领域后续研究的展望。

title: Robust Logical Anomaly Detection under Capture Shifts via Synthetic Anomalies
summary: Detectors of logical anomalies, such as missing, extra or wrongly combined parts, usually score a test image by its distance from normal (good) images. They achieve near-perfect image-level AUROC on standard industrial anomaly detection benchmarks such as MVTec LOCO, but their robustness to changes in capture conditions remains largely unexamined. Under a heterogeneous perturbation protocol in which each test image is randomly kept unaltered or subjected to a brightness reduction or a zoom-out transformation, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, and two of the strongest, CSAD and SALAD, fall from 97.7% and 96.4% to 68.1% and 62.3%. We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. From a short description of each product, a language model derives anomaly types and editing instructions, an image editor applies them to normal images, and the classifier learns to separate the edited images from automatically discovered normal sub-modes. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the perturbation protocol. Trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, so that neither test perturbation occurs in training, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean). These results suggest that clean benchmark scores can hide a strong sensitivity to capture conditions, and that learning the decision from both normal images and rule violations may reduce it.

AI.tldr: 逻辑异常检测依赖"与正常图像比对"的范式，在捕获条件变化下鲁棒性差（AUROC最多掉34.1点）；本文提出用语言模型生成规则违反样本、训练不依赖正常参考的判别分类器，在扰动协议下保持94.1% AUROC。
AI.motivation: 现有逻辑异常检测器（如CSAD、SALAD）通过测试图像与正常图像的距离打分，在MVTec LOCO等基准上接近完美，但其对捕获条件（亮度、缩放）变化的鲁棒性几乎未被检验。作者发现这类方法在异质扰动下性能大幅下降，说明干净基准分数掩盖了强敏感性，需要一种不依赖正常参考的检测范式。
AI.method: 提出一个不进行正常样本比对的分类框架：1) 由产品简短描述经语言模型推导异常类型与编辑指令；2) 图像编辑器据此对正常图像施加编辑，合成异常样本；3) 分类器学习区分编辑图像与自动发现的正常子模式。测试时分类器直接对测试图像打分，无需与正常数据比对。另设不含亮度/缩小增强的训练配置以检验扰动泛化。
AI.result: 对比的normal-reference方法在扰动协议下损失9.7–34.1 AUROC点，最强的CSAD与SALAD分别从97.7%、96.4%降至68.1%、62.3%。本框架完整训练配方在干净图像上达94.9%（低于SALAD/CSAD 1.5–2.8点），扰动协议下达94.1%；不加亮度/缩小增强训练时仍达92.5%（干净93.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 干净基准分数会掩盖检测器对捕获条件的强敏感性；联合从正常图像与规则违反中学习决策边界，可在保持相当准确率的同时显著降低该敏感性。

title: LegalRewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models for Legal Preference Evaluation
summary: Reward models are central to preference alignment for legal tasks, yet existing reward model benchmarks are still primarily centered on general-domain preferences. In this work, we introduce LegalRewardBench, the first human-verified benchmark for evaluating reward models in the legal domain. The benchmark organizes legal preference evaluation into five capability levels: knowledge, understanding, analysis, decision, and writing, and preference examples are constructed through rubric-guided automatic judging combined with human verification. We evaluate three families of judges, covering both general and fine-tuned models, and generative and discriminative architectures. Experimental results show that strong general-purpose generative models are currently the most robust legal reward models, while existing fine-tuned reward models transfer less reliably to legal preference evaluation. We also conduct detailed comparisons of input organizations and training strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向法律领域的奖励模型评测基准 LegalRewardBench，将法律偏好评测划分为知识、理解、分析、决策、写作五个能力层级，样本由评分标准引导的自动评判结合人工校验构建，并对三类评判模型进行评测。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型是法律任务偏好对齐的核心，但现有奖励模型基准仍以通用领域偏好为主，缺乏法律领域的专门评测手段，无法衡量奖励模型在法律偏好上的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建 LegalRewardBench：以五个能力层级（知识、理解、分析、决策、写作）组织法律偏好评测；采用 rubric（评分标准）引导的自动评判与人工校验相结合的方式构造偏好样本；评测三类评判模型，覆盖通用模型与微调模型、生成式与判别式架构；并对输入组织形式与训练策略进行对比分析。
AI.result: 强通用生成式模型目前是最稳健的法律奖励模型；已有微调奖励模型向法律偏好评测的迁移可靠性较低；同时对输入组织方式与训练策略给出了细致的对比结果。
AI.conclusion: LegalRewardBench 填补了法律领域奖励模型评测的空白，表明通用生成式模型在法律偏好判别上优于现有微调奖励模型，提示法律偏好对齐仍需专门的奖励模型设计与训练策略。

title: AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction
summary: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.

AI.tldr: 提出 AffectWorld 基准，用情感-动作-世界状态链条评估世界模型，含三大任务、1,498 个视频样本与 233 个反事实样本，揭示现有模型在情感驱动后果预测上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型基准主要考察物理合理性与感知质量，忽视了情感如何驱动人类行为并进而改变世界状态这一维度，导致情感驱动的世界演化能力缺乏评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 AffectWorld 基准，围绕"情感—动作—世界状态"链条设计三个任务：世界状态一致性、情感-动作一致性、因果一致性；包含 1,498 个日常视频样本，标注合理情感、动作倾向与原子化世界状态约束；另设 233 个反事实样本，在固定场景与事件条件下改变主体情感，检验动作与后果是否随之变化；定义八项指标及一项反事实指标，结合自动视觉评估与人工校准的 VLM/LLM 判断。
AI.result: 对五个 SoTA 世界模型（如 Cosmos3）的评测显示，世界状态变化得分仅 0.100–0.280，反事实情感敏感度得分仅 0.027–0.070（[0,1] 区间），表明模型在生成情感驱动动作后果及根据情感干预调整未来预测方面存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: AffectWorld 为推进能够刻画情感如何塑造未来物理与社会状态的世界模型提供了测试平台。

title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 12 tables. Erfan Shahabi and Amirhossein Roshandel contributed equally
summary: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increases the diversity of expressed preference aspects (filtered aspect entropy: 1.619 vs. 0.859; paired d = 0.96, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). This gain persists when the simulator converses with two trained recommenders, KBRD and UniCRS, under two independent evaluation judges (+0.28 to +0.56 nats; all p < 0.001). Human evaluation finds 94.3% of enriched-attribute claims supported or partially supported, while human judgments agree with 95.2% of the auditor's binary filtering decisions on a stratified sample.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SimInter，通过两个LLM智能体之间的合成访谈，从用户统计画像与历史对话证据中抽取决策风格、方面级偏好、领域专长等隐性行为特征，以增强对话推荐系统（CRS）的用户模拟器；在电影推荐场景下，其模拟用户的偏好方面多样性显著优于仅用统计画像的基线，并在与KBRD、UniCRS对话时保持增益，人工评估支持度达94.3%。
AI.motivation: CRS 需要可靠的用户模拟器以低成本评估，但现有基于 LLM 的模拟器通常仅以显式评分、人口统计和静态来源得到的画像为条件，只能捕捉表层偏好，忽略决策风格、方面级偏好和领域专长等隐性行为特征，导致模拟真实度受限。
AI.method: 提出 SimInter 流水线：以用户统计画像和历史对话证据为基础，通过两个 LLM 智能体之间的合成访谈来抽取隐性行为属性；在画像增强之前，设置审计智能体在轮次级别显式标记潜在的捏造与刻板印象。在电影推荐上实例化，模拟 300 名 ReDial 用户，并在 100 名匹配用户子集上与仅统计画像的基线对比。
AI.result: SimInter 显著提升所表达偏好方面的多样性（过滤后方面熵 1.619 vs. 0.859；配对 d = 0.96，Holm 校正 p < 0.001）；该增益在与 KBRD、UniCRS 两个已训练推荐器对话、由两个独立评估者评判时依然存在（+0.28 至 +0.56 nats，均 p < 0.001）。人工评估显示 94.3% 的增强属性主张得到支持或部分支持，且人工判断与审计智能体二值过滤决策在分层样本上的一致率为 95.2%。
AI.conclusion: 基于合成访谈的隐性行为属性抽取可有效增强 LLM 用户模拟器，在提升偏好表达多样性的同时通过轮次级审计机制抑制捏造与刻板化，且增益在不同推荐器和评估者下具有稳健性，人工验证支持其可靠性。

title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
summary: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“候选列表呈现优化”任务：在给定患者病例与固定排序医生列表下，生成简短、病例相关且基于医生档案的摘要，以帮助患者比较。作者构建基于人物画像条件化LLM的离线模拟患者选择框架，并比较提示级优化(GEPA)、参数级优化(GRPO)及二者组合，发现GRPO显著优于GEPA且效果在不参与优化的第二评审模型下依然稳健，而用GEPA优化提示初始化GRPO可加速训练并取得最高模拟转化率。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统虽能识别相关医生，但患者仍难以比较医生档案并做决策；同时真实患者交互数据稀缺，无法直接用于优化呈现方式，因此需要可离线评估医生呈现效果的框架。
AI.method: 形式化slate presentation optimization任务：输入患者病例与固定排序医生列表，输出简短、病例特定、基于档案信息的可比较摘要。构建离线框架，用人物画像条件化的LLM模拟患者选择；从病例属性抽取生成患者画像；从事实准确性、相关性、自然性及模拟患者选择四方面评估呈现；并使用优化期未见的第二LLM评审检测模拟器特定过拟合。对比GEPA提示级优化、GRPO参数级优化及二者组合，跨两种模型规模实验。
AI.result: GRPO在满足全部约束方面显著优于GEPA，其模拟转化率提升在未见评审下依然保持。GEPA单独使用改进较小，但用其优化提示初始化GRPO可加快训练并达到最高模拟转化率。
AI.conclusion: 提示级优化与参数级优化在改善医生推荐呈现方面具有互补作用。该工作表明可借助离线模拟与多约束评估优化推荐呈现，并通过组合提示与参数优化提升效果与训练效率。

title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
summary: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的遥感框架Omni-RS，支持4个理解任务与5个生成任务，通过场景引导的两阶段训练和细节视觉条件实现多任务联合建模。
AI.motivation: 遥感实际应用通常需要同时对同一地理场景进行理解与生成，但现有方法大多将理解与生成割裂处理，而已有的统一遥感模型的生成能力仅限于文本到图像，无法覆盖更广泛的生成任务。
AI.method: 提出Omni-RS统一框架，涵盖4个遥感理解任务和5个生成任务。核心为"场景引导两阶段训练"策略：先让多模态大语言模型适配遥感理解，再利用其隐藏状态引导扩散Transformer进行图像生成。为支持多生成任务联合学习，构建统一多任务生成数据集UniGen，将异构遥感数据整理为统一格式。同时引入"细节视觉条件"，使用VAE编码的视觉条件引导生成过程，从而支持需要参考图像的额外生成任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Omni-RS在理解任务上表现优异，并在多种生成任务上取得突出结果。
AI.conclusion: Omni-RS通过统一框架与场景引导两阶段训练，有效桥接了遥感理解与生成任务之间的鸿沟，验证了统一建模在遥感多任务中的可行性与优越性。

title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. Project website: https://colorful-liyu.github.io/ShoeFit/ , including proposed multi-view footwear try-on dataset MVShoes-clean
summary: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories and challenging try-on scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a dual-stream DiT architecture, ShoeFit, designed to mitigate viewpoint misalignment through Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding, and alleviate background-induced distortion using the LayeredRefAttention which leverages background features to modulate footwear latents. The proposed framework effectively decouples shoe appearance from environmental interferences while preserving high-quality texture detail through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves rendering fidelity and robustness under challenging real-world product shoes, establishing a new benchmark in high-fidelity footwear try-on synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出虚拟鞋类试穿（VFTON）任务，构建多视角数据集MVShoes并提出双流DiT框架ShoeFit，通过多视角条件与分层参考注意力解决视角错位与背景色彩失真问题，实现高保真鞋类试穿合成。
AI.motivation: 虚拟鞋类试穿（VFTON）在虚拟试穿领域中尚属探索不足的方向，需在保持3D一致性与纹理真实性的同时合成逼真结果。与传统以服装为中心的VTON不同，VFTON面临三大独特挑战：（1）数据稀缺，难以将产品鞋与穿着同一双鞋的模特完美配对；（2）视角错位，目标脚部姿态与源鞋视角总是不一致，导致纹理信息不完整与细节失真；（3）背景引起的色彩失真，鞋类复杂材质与环境光照交互产生非预期的颜色污染。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：一是构建MVShoes多视角鞋类试穿数据集，含7305个标注良好的图像三元组，覆盖多样鞋类类别与挑战性试穿场景；二是提出双流DiT架构ShoeFit，通过带3D旋转位置嵌入的多视角条件（Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding）缓解视角错位，并通过分层参考注意力（LayeredRefAttention）利用背景特征调制鞋类隐变量以减轻背景引起的失真。该框架通过解耦的去噪分支与条件分支，将鞋类外观与环境干扰分离，同时保留高质量纹理细节。
AI.result: 大量定量与定性实验表明，该方法在真实世界产品鞋的挑战性场景下显著提升了渲染保真度与鲁棒性，为高保真鞋类试穿合成建立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地定义并研究虚拟鞋类试穿任务，通过MVShoes数据集与ShoeFit框架有效应对数据稀缺、视角错位和背景色彩失真三大挑战，推动了高保真鞋类试穿合成的发展。

title: Jev-Guard: Fast Routing and Auditing Agent Actions over Editable Policy Trees
summary: Agent harnesses require a low-latency guardrail model together with customizable audit policies. However, deploying an auto-regressive guardrail model remains challenging: such models incur high inference latency and are often poorly aligned with customized policies. To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. We further construct a policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, spanning diverse domains including content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Specifically, Jev-Guard first navigates the policy tree to select the applicable audit policy given the caller's audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved policies. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72\% safety accuracy, a mean latency of 58ms, and 93.10\% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240ms. Furthermore, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness framework. Across agent trajectories, its separate permission gate cuts mean review time per task from 4.80s for an SFT-LLM judge to 1.33s, with no policy violations are observed for either guard.

AI.tldr: 提出Jev-Guard统一模型，通过策略树路由实现低延迟、可定制的安全分类与策略路由。
AI.motivation: Agent harness需要低延迟护栏模型与可定制审计策略，但自回归护栏模型推理延迟高且难以对齐自定义策略。
AI.method: 构建覆盖内容审核、网络安全、隐私、法律合规等领域的策略树；Jev-Guard先依据调用者审计上下文在策略树中导航选择适用审计策略，再基于检索到的策略进行安全分类。
AI.result: 在7,033个评测案例上达到93.72%安全准确率、58ms平均延迟、93.10%层次路由准确率，完整路由加分类流程平均240ms；集成到Hermes harness后，独立权限门将每任务平均审查时间从SFT-LLM评判器的4.80s降至1.33s，两种护栏均未观察到策略违规。
AI.conclusion: Jev-Guard以统一模型兼顾低延迟与可定制策略，可作为Agent harness的高效护栏方案。

title: Probing the Geometry of Color Representations in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Do multilingual language models learn a universal internal geometry for color, and is it perceptually grounded or primarily linguistic? We decompose color representations into two geometric axes: (P1) alignment to perceptual color space, and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. Analyzing layerwise embeddings across models and multilingual datasets, we find that perceptual grounding is weak: alignment to CIE-LAB peaks in intermediate layers, then collapses toward output layers. Cross-lingual symmetry degrades with depth, suggesting later layers encode language-specific structure. Functionally, we show that geometric properties predict task performance: models achieve 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where P1 alignment peaks, with P1 alignment (r=0.70) significantly correlating with downstream capabilities. Our results reveal a dissociation: text-only LMs learn universal color-language geometry, not universal color-perception geometry, providing diagnostics for where perceptual structure is preserved in language models.

AI.tldr: 本文分解多语言语言模型的颜色表征为两个几何轴：与感知色彩空间的对齐（P1）和跨语言对称性（P2）。分析发现感知接地较弱——CIE-LAB对齐在中间层达到峰值后向输出层崩塌，跨语言对称性随深度退化，且几何属性可预测下游任务性能，揭示模型学到的是通用的颜色-语言几何而非颜色-感知几何。
AI.motivation: 探究多语言语言模型是否习得通用的颜色内部几何，并判断这种几何是源于感知接地还是主要源于语言结构。
AI.method: 将颜色表征解耦为两个几何轴：(P1)与感知色彩空间的对其、(P2)跨语言对称性；对多模型、多语言数据集的逐层嵌入进行分析，并检验几何属性与任务性能的功能关系。
AI.result: 感知接地较弱：CIE-LAB对齐在中间层达到峰值，随后向输出层崩塌；跨语言对称性随深度增加而退化，表明深层编码语言特定结构。P1对齐峰值层上颜色分类准确率达96.7%，且P1对齐与下游能力显著相关（r=0.70）。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示一种解离：纯文本语言模型学到的是通用的颜色-语言几何，而非通用的颜色-感知几何，为定位语言模型中感知结构保留位置提供了诊断手段。

title: CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations
summary: Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从单张低空航拍RGB图像生成大规模、实例级参数化3D城市的新设定，并构建CityCode表示与Air2Code生成方法，实现持久、可被智能体操作的城市状态。
AI.motivation: 城市空间智能需要智能体能在连续任务中度量、解读并修改的3D城市。维持这种持久、基于代码的状态，要求轻量化获取方式，并支持一致的状态更新而无需反复进行密集重建。
AI.method: 提出CityCode：一种可由智能体操作的表示，通过持久实体标识统一度量几何、城市拓扑、视觉语义与3D资产，并采用依赖感知的版本化执行以支持经验证的更新与历史恢复。开发Air2Code：结合视觉结构提取与适配的度量深度估计构建该表示；针对遮挡与覆盖不完整，利用恢复结构与观测外观引导生成式补全，并进行结构感知的建筑与背景3D生成。
AI.result: 在CitySample-Aerial与UrbanScene3D上，相比所评估的基线，度量结构恢复更准确、对目标城市的视觉保真度更高。在50条各含50步的任务链中，CityCode支持对演化城市状态的持续查询、编辑、规划与历史恢复。
AI.conclusion: CityCode与Air2Code共同将稀疏航拍观测转化为持久、可智能体操作的城市世界，服务于长时程城市空间智能。

title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
summary: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavarian disadvantage. Although Bavarian, a low-resource dialect, has lower baseline accuracy than German and English, the language most affected at 4 bits varies across models and quantisation methods. Calibration further shapes these cross-language effects: the relative Bavarian--German effect changes with calibration language, while changing the calibration source has little average effect on GPTQ-4 but can affect AWQ-4 much more strongly. Free-form evaluation on five models further shows that 4-bit compression can degrade generated responses even in settings where multiple-choice accuracy changes only modestly, while 8-bit GPTQ remains comparatively stable. Overall, our results show that quantisation robustness for regional language varieties depends on the model, quantisation method, calibration data, and evaluation setting, and cannot be measured by aggregate multilingual accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过BAVGROUND基准（206个三语对齐多选题），比较14个7B–10B开源指令模型在BF16、8-bit GPTQ及两种4-bit量化（GPTQ、AWQ）下的表现，考察量化是否会对巴伐利亚方言、标准德语和英语的语言能力造成不对称损害。结果表明8-bit GPTQ接近BF16且保持语言间相对行为，而4-bit量化显著不稳定，但这种不稳定未转化为一致的巴伐利亚劣势。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化可降低大语言模型内存开销，但压缩是否对方言等区域语言变体的能力保持与标准语同样可靠尚不清楚。现有评估多依赖聚合多语言准确率，可能掩盖跨语言和跨设置的不对称退化，因此需要受控、跨语言对齐的基准来检验量化对方言鲁棒性的影响。
AI.method: 构建BAVGROUND多选题基准，将206个源问题在巴伐利亚语、标准德语和英语间对齐。在14个7B–10B开源指令模型上，对比BF16、8-bit GPTQ、4-bit GPTQ和4-bit AWQ，分析平均准确率变化、BF16决策翻转比例及其与模型不确定性的关系。进一步改变校准语言与校准数据来源，考察其对跨语言效应的调节作用，并在5个模型上进行自由生成评估。
AI.result: 8-bit GPTQ基本接近BF16并大体保留三种语言的相对行为；两种4-bit方法平均准确率下降约1.4–1.5个百分点，改变11.9–16.0%的BF16决策，且变化集中于BF16模型本就不确定的样本。该不稳定未导致一致的巴伐利亚劣势：巴伐利亚语基线准确率虽低于德语和英语，但4-bit下受影响最大的语言因模型与量化方法而异。校准语言会改变巴伐利亚语–德语的相对效应；更换校准来源对GPTQ-4平均影响较小，但对AWQ-4影响明显更大。自由生成评估显示，4-bit压缩可在多选题准确率变化不大时仍损害生成质量，而8-bit GPTQ相对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 区域语言变体的量化鲁棒性取决于模型、量化方法、校准数据和评估设置，无法仅用聚合多语言准确率来衡量。评估后训练量化时需采用跨语言对齐、区分任务形式（判别式与生成式）的诊断性基准。

title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
summary: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

AI.tldr: Urbex 将城市级 3D 定位建模为主动式空间搜索，用 VLM 智能体在多视图交互环境中逐步查询、缩放、渲染并输出定位框，经强化学习训练后在 CityRefer 上取得最优 Hit@1 与 IoU，且无需候选框并显著快于最强基线。
AI.motivation: 既有城市级 3D 定位普遍采用候选排序范式，依赖预生成的实例候选框，在大规模室外场景中效率低下。
AI.method: 将城市级 3D 场景表示为可交互多视图环境，VLM 智能体可查询地标、放大局部区域、渲染斜视角并提交定位框；在 CityRefer 上用强化学习优化工具使用策略，采用平滑定位奖励与轻量塑形奖励促进高效探索。
AI.result: 在 CityRefer 上取得最佳 Hit@1 与 IoU，支持无需真值框的无候选定位，并显著快于最强城市级排序基线；在 STPLS3D-Refer 上的零样本结果进一步表明跨场景鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 主动式空间搜索范式可替代候选排序，实现更高效、无需候选且跨场景更鲁棒的城市级 3D 定位。

title: Pin It on Anyone: Certified Targeted Displacement of Multi-Bit LLM Watermarks Without the Key
summary: Multi-bit watermarking embeds a message, typically an account identifier, into LLM output so that harmful text can be traced to its origin. We show an attack technique that allows to alter the watermarking message. This allows to, for example, exchange the embedded account ID to an arbitrary different one. The attacker mainly needs access to a few accounts for generating LLM output and model logits, but crucially not the secret key used to watermark. The attacker then rewrites the text, keeping its meaning, so that the watermarking message decoder recovers the watermarking message embedded by the attacker. We are, to our knowledge, the first to propose such an attack, which we call a targeted displacement. Theoretically, we present upper and lower bounds on the probability of our attack succeeding. This bound depends on the number of accounts the attacker has access to, the length of the message and some characteristics of the given text. Our attack can succeed whenever we can bound the ambiguity of the generated text well enough. Empirically, we test our attack technique against five watermarking methods and four LLMs. Attack success tracks our predicted bounds, allowing us to alter watermarking messages in almost all cases with high accuracy, given enough accounts. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Batorskq/PinIt.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出针对LLM多比特水印的"定向位移"攻击：攻击者无需密钥，仅借助少量账户和模型logits即可在保持语义的前提下改写文本，使水印解码器输出攻击者指定的消息（如冒充他人账户ID）。
AI.motivation: 多比特水印将账户标识嵌入LLM输出以溯源有害文本，其安全性假设（密钥保密）是否足够稳健尚未被检验。作者希望揭示：即使密钥不泄露，仅凭少量账户访问权限也能篡改水印消息，从而破坏溯源机制的可信度。
AI.method: 提出"定向位移"攻击。攻击者持有若干账户，可生成LLM输出并获取模型logits，但不知道水印密钥。通过分析目标水印消息与当前消息的差异，对文本进行保持语义的改写，使解码器恢复出攻击者期望的消息。理论上给出攻击成功概率的上界与下界，该界取决于可用账户数量、消息长度及文本本身的歧义度特性。
AI.result: 在5种水印方法和4个LLM上进行实证测试，攻击成功率与理论预测的界高度吻合；在账户数量充足时，几乎能在所有情况下高精度地篡改水印消息。
AI.conclusion: 多比特水印的安全性不仅依赖密钥保密，还受限于文本歧义度和账户可及性；当文本歧义可被充分约束时，定向位移攻击即可成功。这提示现有水印方案需要额外的防护设计来抵御此类消息篡改，代码已开源。

title: Visual Sevoing from Lines
summary: In this work, we present a fundamentally new approach to visual servoing using lines. It is based on a theoretical and geometrical study of the main line representations which allowed us to define a new representation, the so-called binormalized Plucker coordinates. They are particularly well suited to visual servoing. Indeed, they allow the definition of a proper image line alignment concept. The control law which realizes such an alignment has moreover several properties: partial decoupling between rotation and translation, analytical inversion of the motion equations and global asymptotic stability conditions. This control law was validated both in simulation and experimentally in the specific case of an orthogonal trihedron.

AI.tldr: 提出基于"双归一化Plücker坐标"的直线视觉伺服新方法，实现图像直线对齐控制律，具备旋转-平移部分解耦、运动方程解析求逆及全局渐近稳定性，并通过仿真与正交三面体实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉伺服多基于点特征，直线特征的表示方式繁多且缺乏适配伺服控制的统一表示，难以定义合理的图像直线对齐概念。作者希望通过对直线表示的理论与几何研究，找到一种更适合视觉伺服的直线表示。
AI.method: 对主要直线表示进行理论与几何分析，据此定义新的表示——双归一化Plücker坐标；基于该表示提出图像直线对齐概念，并设计对应控制律。推导该控制律的性质：旋转与平移的部分解耦、运动方程的解析求逆、全局渐近稳定条件。在正交三面体这一特定场景下进行仿真与实验验证。
AI.result: 所提出控制律在仿真和实验中均得到验证（针对正交三面体场景），并证实其具备旋转-平移部分解耦、运动方程可解析求逆以及全局渐近稳定等性质。
AI.conclusion: 双归一化Plücker坐标是适合视觉伺服的直线表示，能够定义合理的图像直线对齐概念，并支撑具备良好控制性质的控制律。

title: Hallucination-aware Faithful Reasoning in Remote Sensing
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities for remote sensing reasoning, yet they frequently generate visually unsupported reasoning that contradicts the visual evidence. Existing post-training methods optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for identifying and correcting hallucinations that arise during the reasoning process. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{FaithRS}, a hallucination-aware self-reflection framework for faithful reasoning in remote sensing. We first construct \textbf{SFHD-43K}, a dataset of 43K structured, fine-grained hallucination annotations, and train a detector to identify hallucination types, underlying causes, and supporting visual evidence. FaithRS then incorporates this diagnostic feedback into a Safe Detector-Guided Corrective Rollout framework, where a safety-aware gate selectively determines whether and how to revise the response. Training is driven by a composite reward that jointly optimizes answer accuracy, reasoning faithfulness, hallucination reduction, format compliance, and revision safety. Experiments with Qwen3.5 backbones (0.8B, 4B, and 9B) show consistent improvements across four remote sensing benchmarks, with gains of up to 11.64 points.

AI.tldr: 提出FaithRS幻觉感知自反思框架，通过SFHD-43K数据集训练检测器提供诊断反馈，结合安全门控的修正rollout与复合奖励训练，在遥感推理中显著减少幻觉并提升多个基准性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在遥感推理中常生成与视觉证据相矛盾的、缺乏视觉支撑的推理内容；现有后训练方法主要优化最终答案正确性，对推理过程中出现的幻觉缺乏识别与纠正的监督信号。
AI.method: 1) 构建SFHD-43K，包含4.3万条结构化、细粒度幻觉标注；2) 训练检测器识别幻觉类型、潜在成因及支撑视觉证据；3) 将诊断反馈融入安全检测器引导的修正rollout框架，用安全感知门控决定是否及如何修订回答；4) 采用联合优化答案准确性、推理忠实性、幻觉削减、格式合规与修订安全性的复合奖励进行训练。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3.5骨干（0.8B、4B、9B）在四个遥感基准上取得一致提升，最高增益达11.64分。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模推理过程中的幻觉并提供诊断式反馈与安全修正机制，FaithRS有效提升了遥感多模态推理的忠实性与准确性，验证了幻觉感知自反思范式的有效性。

title: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://souglad21.github.io/SchemaPose/
summary: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SchemaPose，一个基于schema引导的RGB类别级9D位姿估计框架，通过显式参数化schema建模类别规律与实例变化，并在端到端query框架中用schema变量引导位姿预测，在合成与真实数据上达到RGB方法中的SOTA。
AI.motivation: RGB类别级9D位姿估计极具挑战：单目系统需泛化到未见实例，同时联合推断3D平移、旋转和尺寸。相比实例级，类别级设置要求网络学习类别内共享结构与实例间差异。RGB-only场景下位姿线索、类别共性与实例变化在无几何约束的外观中纠缠，使现有框架难以学到与类别级目标对齐的表示。
AI.method: 提出SchemaPose框架：为估计流程引入显式参数化schema，用于建模类别级规律及结构化实例变化；利用推断出的schema变量在端到端query-based框架中引导位姿相关预测；同一套公式统一支持模板实例化、合成标注与位姿学习。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上的实验表明，SchemaPose在RGB类别级9D位姿估计方法中取得了state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式schema引导能够有效解耦类别共性与实例变化，为RGB类别级9D位姿估计提供了统一且有效的表示学习与预测范式。

title: Noise2Match: Self-Supervised Low-Dose CT Denoising via Adaptive Inter-Slice Matching
summary: With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid misalignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose conebeam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain selfsupervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.

AI.tldr: 提出Noise2Match：基于自适应层间匹配的自监督LDCT去噪方法，通过建模相邻切片标签转换并校正去噪输出以满足等均值条件，理论上等价于监督训练，并首次有效实现图像域低剂量CBCT自监督去噪。
AI.motivation: 监督式CNN去噪依赖难以获取的配对噪声-干净数据；经典自监督方法假设噪声像素级独立，对LDCT的相关噪声无效；近期利用相邻LDCT切片的自监督方法未有效处理解剖变异导致的层间非刚性失配，难以满足Noise2Noise的等均值条件。
AI.method: Noise2Match引入层间匹配网络，建模相邻切片间的标签转换过程，并据此对去噪器输出进行校正，使其更好地满足等均值条件；同时理论证明在理想条件下，用相邻LDCT切片训练等价于配对噪声-干净图像的监督训练。
AI.result: Noise2Match在低剂量CT去噪上优于现有图像域自监督方法；并发现其能有效进行低剂量CBCT去噪（归因于校正操作降低层间噪声相关性），据称是首个有效的图像域低剂量CBCT自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: Noise2Match通过自适应层间匹配与输出校正，在不需配对数据的情况下实现了接近监督训练的LDCT与CBCT去噪，具备更广的适用性与更高的实用价值。

title: ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \textbf{Reasoning--Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence--answer candidates and a \textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReDiS 框架，将多模态大模型在遥感理解中的推理探索与候选评估解耦并协同进化，通过 Reasoner 与 Diagnoser 双角色专家及失败触发恢复机制，在多个遥感基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 遥感任务要求细粒度视觉定位与多步推理，而现有 MLLM 方法依赖昂贵的预构建推理轨迹或自生成信号（如响应一致性），易强化共享错误、提供不可靠监督，导致推理不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 Reasoning–Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS) 框架：从共享多模态骨干实例化两个角色专家——Reasoner 探索多样视觉证据-答案候选，Diagnoser 联合评估完整候选集并给出可信度感知反馈；两者在 Reasoner 暴露新候选分布与失败模式时协同进化。另引入 Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)，在组内样本全错、组相对优势消失时提供最小结果级纠正，不规定中间推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在 LHRS-Bench、MME-RS、CHOICE 上，相比 Qwen3.5 骨干在 0.8B、2B、4B 规模均取得一致提升；0.8B 规模类别平均准确率提升 6.47 个百分点，ReDiS-4B 在对比的遥感 MLLM 中取得最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: ReDiS 通过解耦推理探索与候选评估并允许二者协同进化，为遥感多模态推理提供更可靠的监督信号，FTR 缓解全错组优势消失问题，实验验证了其有效性。

title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over uncalibrated scores while remaining competitive with rubric-based methods. A controlled SummEval comparison yields similar agreement for rubric-derived quality probes and style probes, supporting calibration without reproducing rubric criteria. The learned coefficients reveal shared and opposing correction directions across judges.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM方法，通过对显式评测偏置的响应建模（代理雅可比+岭回归）校正LLM评判者的隐式打分偏差，无需逐项评分标准即可提升与人类排名的一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM作为评判者可降低成本，但其打分与人类判断存在系统性偏差；本文探究能否利用对"显式施加的评测偏置"的响应，来纠正评判者的"隐式打分偏差"。
AI.method: PRISM（Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment）：固定被评内容，测量属性被强调/弱化时的分数变化；用局部敏感性模型将响应表示为代理雅可比（surrogate Jacobian）；基于人类标签用岭回归学习对基线分数的校正。该协议无需评分细则，仅用总体分数。
AI.result: 在SummEval摘要与HANNA故事评测的Jev和Sol主比较中，PRISM及学习基线变体显著提升与人类排名的一致性，且与基于细则的方法相当；受控SummEval实验中，细则导出的质量探针与风格探针取得相近一致性；学习到的系数显示不同评判者间存在共享与相反的校正方向。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式偏置探针的响应可校准LLM评判者的隐式偏差，无需依赖评分细则，为低成本、可迁移的LLM评测校准提供了可行路径。

title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

AI.tldr: 提出免训练两阶段视觉token剪枝方法Bifocal，通过混合粒度框架分离查询相关与图像内在证据，在保留约1/4视觉token时于全部能力组均保持90%以上原性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM视觉token剪枝方法在通用VQA基准上看似高效，但作者对10种方法、3个模型族、5类能力组的评测发现：通用性能的维持往往以OCR、视觉定位等细粒度任务严重退化为代价。其根源在于主流范式（保留最高分原生patch）的两点缺陷：单一重要性排序忽视不同任务所需的互补证据；稀疏patch选择破坏图像内容与空间完整性。
AI.method: Bifocal为免训练两阶段剪枝，基于混合粒度框架：为查询相关证据与图像内在证据分别分配预算，并辅以全图池化粗表示。LLM之前，通过软合取将问题词与视觉区域匹配，并与去偏范数的图像显著性平衡，同时以最大化表示覆盖度选择图像内在证据；LLM内部，进一步利用密度调整的文本到图像注意力剪枝token。
AI.result: 在约1/4原始视觉token下，Bifocal是唯一在三个模型的所有能力组中均保持90%以上未剪枝性能的方法，并在全部9个模型-预算设置中平均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token剪枝需兼顾查询相关与图像内在互补证据并保持空间完整性；Bifocal的混合粒度两阶段设计可有效缓解细粒度任务退化，实现跨模型、跨能力的稳健压缩。

title: Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.

AI.tldr: 该论文为掩码扩散模型引入多条持久残差流及自适应路由，双流结构将重构困惑度在验证集降低5.71%、外部语料平均降低5.13%，并揭示可见位置与掩码位置自发形成不同的读写路由模式。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型并行重建掩码token，但标准Transformer主干将可见证据与不断演化的掩码预测混在单一残差流中，两类互补信息相互干扰，缺乏分离与持久保持机制。
AI.method: 为掩码扩散模型配备多条贯穿深度的残差流与流间自适应路由；分析无预设角色下的路由模式，并通过因果干预（读写路由、token级写强度）与状态干预进行机制验证；进一步训练带角色条件路由（role-conditioned routing）的模型。
AI.result: 双流使重构困惑度在验证数据上降低5.71%，外部语料平均降低5.13%；可见与掩码位置在无预设角色时学到不同路由模式；因果干预表明该区分组织读/写路由，token级写强度在各角色内仍关键；角色条件路由可恢复加第二流带来收益的一半；状态干预显示额外流保留了早期token表示以供后续复用，同时证据在掩码位置累积；该机制在更大模型规模上重现。
AI.conclusion: 持久多残差流配合自适应路由能够分离并协同支持"上下文保持"与"预测精炼"两种角色，为扩散语言模型主干设计提供了机制性依据，且该效应可扩展至更大规模模型。

title: Prompt-Injection Probes Learn the Conversation, Not Just the Injection
summary: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出间接提示注入检测中线性探针的标准评估存在严重缺陷，并通过在训练数据中加入匹配负样本，大幅降低了探针误报率，同时保持较高攻击检出率。
AI.motivation: 线性探针被用作间接提示注入的廉价监控器，用于筛查智能体读取的工具输出并将可疑内容送入二次检查，因此每次误报都有成本。然而探针只学习训练样本中可区分的特征，标准评估可能被无需模型参与的伪特征（如对话位置、文本长度）通过，且探针会把无害但格式相似的内容误判为注入，说明现有评估与训练数据设计不足以衡量真实的检测能力。
AI.method: 作者在训练数据中引入匹配负样本：将每个攻击与同一对话但无注入的版本对比，并加入格式类似注入的无害文本。通过仅改变训练数据（保持探针架构与评估流程不变），在六个开源模型上评估探针表现。
AI.result: 在训练中见过的应用中、默认阈值下，仅改变训练数据即可将无注入对话的误报率从41-80%降至4-27%，将无害相似文本的误报率从92-98%降至3-16%。在按正常流量设定阈值时，探针仍能中位数捕获95%成功欺骗智能体的攻击（不使用新数据时为91%）。在新应用中误报率保持较低，但检出率取决于模型和阈值设定方式。同样数据也能提升纯文本过滤器。
AI.conclusion: 标准注入探针评估可被表面特征轻易通过，加入匹配负样本的训练数据是降低误报、提升实际可用性的关键；该方法在已见应用上效果显著，在新应用上误报可控但检出率受模型与阈值影响，且可推广至文本过滤器。

title: Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs
summary: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了三类提示适配方法（离散提示优化、prompt tuning、prefix tuning）在稠密与MoE语言模型中如何改变内部计算，发现适配位置决定任务信息传递路径，且现有表征层面的度量受通用上下文变化干扰，难以区分有效适配与匹配安慰剂。
AI.motivation: 现有提示适配方法通常仅以下游性能进行比较，但相似的输出未必源于相似的内部计算；因此需要理解不同适配方法在模型内部究竟改变了什么，并建立更可靠的评估与解释框架。
AI.method: 研究对比离散提示优化、prompt tuning 与 prefix tuning 三种方法；分析其在稠密模型与混合专家（MoE）模型中的信息传递机制，并考察常见表征层面度量在区分有用适配与匹配安慰剂（matched placebo）时的表现。
AI.result: 适配所在位置可预测任务信息如何传递到输出：优化文本主要改变响应构建；输入级提示将影响写入内容表征；逐层前缀通过注意力维持直接控制。在MoE模型中，这些差异进一步导致不同的专家路由模式。同时，常见表征度量对通用上下文变化高度敏感，无法可靠区分有用适配与匹配安慰剂。
AI.conclusion: 理解提示适配需将表征漂移与其中与任务计算对齐并被因果使用的部分区分开来；该视角为选择、评估和解释提示适配方法提供了实践指导。

title: Revisiting the Estimation of Unigram Surprisal in Computational Psycholinguistics
summary: Contextual and unigram surprisal are standard predictors of reading time in computational psycholinguistics. While contextual surprisal is typically derived from neural language models, unigram surprisal is usually obtained from independent corpus counts. Although both quantities are deterministic functionals of a single underlying distribution---capturing conditional and marginal structure respectively---this practice breaks their probabilistic link and may introduce estimation error from the mismatch. We propose three principles for estimating unigram surprisal in psycholinguistic research, including the requirement that both quantities be derived from the same language model. We operationalize this principle by introducing a Monte Carlo estimator of unigram surprisal from a language model, along with a marginalized variant that has lower variance empirically. When unigram surprisal is re-estimated under this unified framework, we find evidence that predictors change in their predictive contribution to reading time. We also confirm prior findings that frequency can be a stronger predictor of processing effort than contextual surprisal under this unified framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从同一语言模型中统一估计上下文意外度与一元意外度的三条原则，并给出基于蒙特卡洛的一元意外度估计方法。
AI.motivation: 现有心理语言学研究将上下文意外度（来自神经语言模型）与一元意外度（来自独立语料计数）分开估计，虽理论上均为同一分布的确定性泛函，但这种做法破坏了二者的概率联系并可能引入估计误差。
AI.method: 提出三条一元意外度估计原则，核心是要求两个量来自同一语言模型；据此设计语言模型的一元意外度蒙特卡洛估计器，以及经验方差更低的边缘化变体。
AI.result: 在统一框架下重新估计一元意外度后，预测变量对阅读时间的预测贡献发生变化；同时确认了先前发现，即在该统一框架下频率对加工努力的预测力可强于上下文意外度。
AI.conclusion: 应统一从同一语言模型推导上下文意外度与一元意外度，以维持概率一致性；该框架的实证结果改写了阅读时间预测变量的相对贡献。

title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次独立复现五种事实性对齐方法（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DPO、KTO），在统一基准与指标下比较，发现无一方法能完全复现，且均未显著优于基座模型；奖励实际优化的是格式/长度而非事实性，评估环节亦存在缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLM经预训练和监督微调后虽已对齐人类偏好，但标准RLHF对齐步骤并不关注事实性，模型仍可能生成非事实内容并带来不良后果。现有事实性对齐方法虽声称在各自基准上提升事实性，却未被独立复现，且因基座模型、训练数据、评估集、评判器与指标各异而无法横向比较，因此亟需统一条件下的独立复现与比较。
AI.method: 作者对五种事实性对齐方法进行首次独立复现，涵盖在线策略RL（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO）与离线偏好优化（DPO、KTO），并在统一基准与统一评估指标下进行对比。
AI.result: 结果显示：没有任何一种方法能够完全复现原论文结果；在统一基准上，所有方法均未显著优于基座模型。进一步分析发现，奖励实际优化的是格式、长度或简短性，而非事实性与相关性；在线策略与离线训练之间的选择影响甚微。此外，评估指标与基准本身也存在问题，未能衡量文本与提示的相关性；由于提示缺乏标准答案，依赖LLM评判器与检索验证也使评估变得脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 现有事实性对齐方法在当前复现与统一评估条件下未能展现可靠的事实性提升，且评估体系存在系统性缺陷。作者公开了代码、数据与检查点，以支持后续研究。

title: Resource-Efficient 3D Shape and Orientation Estimation of Road Users using Roadside RGB Camera and 3D Radar
comment: Accepted at the 18th IEEE Symposium Sensor Data Fusion: Trends, Solutions and Applications (SDF 2026), Bonn, Germany
summary: End-to-end deep learning pipelines for camera-radar 3D object detection are well established in driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles; however, adapting them to roadside-mounted infrastructure presents significant challenges. On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform, allowing end-to-end models to generalize effectively. On the contrary, roadside sensor installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations, rendering end-to-end models prone to failure and difficult to adapt without massive location-specific datasets. Hence, instead of designing a complex end-to-end pipeline for direct 3D bounding box estimation, a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation. The first stage utilizes any off-the-shelf, state-of-the-art method to extract 2D camera bounding boxes and associated 3D radar points for each road user. The proposed second stage then processes these inputs to construct 3D oriented bounding boxes where radar data determines 3D position, predefined templates define size for each road user, and a tiny neural network predicts a site-specific and optimized yaw angle. The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对路侧相机-雷达3D目标检测提出一种低成本、资源高效的两阶段方法，通过解耦感知与3D框构建，避免了对大规模位置特定数据的依赖，并在NVIDIA Jetson ORIN上实现25 FPS实时性能。
AI.motivation: 车端相机-雷达端到端3D检测已成熟，但迁移到路侧基础设施面临挑战：车端传感器高度、俯仰角与相对几何基本一致，模型易泛化；而路侧安装的高度、倾角和视场因位置差异极大，端到端模型易失效，且难以在缺乏大量位置特定数据集的情况下适配。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法替代复杂的端到端流程。第一阶段用任意现成SOTA方法提取每个道路使用者的2D相机检测框及关联3D雷达点；第二阶段基于这些输入构建3D有向包围盒：雷达数据确定3D位置，预定义模板确定各类道路使用者尺寸，微型神经网络预测站点特定且优化的偏航角。
AI.result: 在带交叉口（含行人、自行车、汽车）的弯道场景完成验证，在NVIDIA Jetson ORIN上达到25 FPS，满足实时应用需求。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式两阶段设计以低成本、低算力实现路侧实时3D形状与朝向估计，规避了端到端模型对位置特定数据的强依赖，验证了在多变路侧安装条件下的可行性与实时性。

title: Agaram 2.5B: The First Tamil-First Language Model Trained from Scratch with Tool Calling. A Playbook for Under-Represented Languages
summary: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了从头训练的25亿参数泰米尔语-英语双语模型Agaram 2.5B，在8×H100上以约500亿token训练6天，支持泰米尔文、罗马化泰米尔文和英文对话与工具调用，翻译性能优于Sarvam-1，但知识类任务接近随机水平。
AI.motivation: 前代模型Agaram 1.5B的失败经验促成本次设计选择；作者希望以低成本、自有资金和算力积分，构建一个覆盖泰米尔文、Tanglish与英文、并具备工具调用能力的开源泰米尔语-英语语言模型，同时验证在有限预算下从零训练小规模双语模型的可行性与局限。
AI.method: 从零训练25亿参数模型，约500亿token（58%泰米尔语，其余为英语、数学、代码与平行文本），在单节点8×H100上约6天完成，并采用保留换行符的新分词器。随后用134,428段对话进行监督微调（回复由开源权重教师模型生成），并进行三轮简短定向训练以形成聊天模型，使其支持泰米尔文、罗马化泰米尔文（Tanglish）和英文回答及工具调用。评估涵盖FLORES与IN22六方向翻译、IndicIFEval、知识/阅读理解基准、25条工具提示及50道人工编写的日常问题（由LLM裁判评分）。
AI.result: 在25条训练中出现过schema的工具提示中，正确选择工具23次、给出完全正确参数13次。翻译在全部六个FLORES和IN22方向上优于2B Indic基座Sarvam-1：FLORES chrF译入泰米尔语54.3、译入英语55.2（对比49.2和44.2）；原生泰米尔语IndicIFEval达19.3%（基座为10.0%）。知识能力薄弱：阅读理解与知识基准接近随机；50道留出日常问题中，LLM裁判判定46%可用（50题中22–24题，三轮；23/50的95%区间为33–60%），失败几乎全是事实错误。两次额外SFT实验仅改变答案格式，未改善知识指标。
AI.conclusion: Agaram 2.5B证明在约1.33万美元预算内可从零训练出具备多文字对话与工具调用能力的泰米尔语-英语模型，翻译与指令遵循显著优于同类基座，但知识存储仍是主要短板。论文还描述了Agaram 1.5B的失败、裁判评分在相同回复上的波动，以及定向训练针对的具体项目与前沿模型文本进入数据的位置；权重与GGUF文件已发布，许可证待法律审查后公布。

title: Receiver Decides Agent-to-Agent Negotiations
summary: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 一次涉及15个智能体、1,049场谈判的循环赛中，决定转账金额的主要是"持有方"而非"请求方"：持有者身份解释47%的金额方差，请求者身份仅解释2%；仅靠持有者首轮拒绝率即可对其总损失进行排序（Spearman = -0.73），且微调可双向大幅改变该行为。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体语言模型交互中，"谁决定资金转移量"这一问题尚不明确，通常评估侧重请求方（说服者）能力。本文旨在厘清请求方与持有方对谈判结果的决定性作用，并检验训练（如说服微调）对智能体作为资源持有者行为的影响，从而提出评估资源型智能体的正确角色设定。
AI.method: 设计循环赛：15个智能体、1,049场谈判。每局中请求者试图从被告知需保留100美元禀赋的持有者处筹钱。通过方差分解比较"持有者身份"与"请求者身份"对转账金额的解释力；剔除极端智能体做稳健性检验；将请求者诉求对象由具名个人改为群体，比较措辞与转账金额差异；以首轮拒绝率对持有者总损失排序；对Qwen3-8B进行几乎无拒绝样本的说服语料微调，并将两个"从不亏损"持有者蒸馏为4B学生模型。
AI.result: 持有者身份解释47%的转账金额方差，请求者身份仅2%；剔除最极端智能体后为22%对4%。个人与群体两种诉求框架下请求者措辞改变，但转账金额统计上等价。损失最少的持有者倾向拒绝开场请求，其首轮拒绝率可对总损失排序（Spearman = -0.73）。训练双向影响该行为：说服语料微调使Qwen3-8B作为持有者让出比例从12%升至84%禀赋；蒸馏两个从不亏损持有者使4B学生损失从95%降至1%。
AI.conclusion: 谈判中持有方行为而非请求方身份主导资金转移结果，且该行为高度可被训练重塑、方向可逆。因此对持有资源的智能体进行评估时，必须将其置于持有者角色，尤其是在说服类微调之后。

title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
summary: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.

AI.tldr: 提出随机分块策展（RBC），用随机实验测量每条经验教训对任务成功率的真实效果，从而在多个策略手册中选出最优者。
AI.motivation: 现有持久文本记忆系统（如ACE、Dynamic Cheatsheet）把"保留哪些经验教训"的决策交给智能体自身判断，导致性能极不稳定——同一流程生成的策略手册可能帮助任务，也可能使表现比不用手册低多达69.6分。因此需要按经验教训对任务成功的实测效果来估值，而非依赖智能体的主观判断。
AI.method: RBC在练习任务上做随机对照实验：将相关经验教训分组为足够大、能引起可测成功率变化的"块"；在每个练习任务上随机决定是否包含每个块。随机化使含块与不含块的任务可比较，其成功率之差即为该块效果的估计。保留有正效果的块；鉴于同一流程既可能生成有益也可能生成有害的手册，系统会培育多本手册，并在新的练习回合中选用表现最佳的完整手册或不使用手册。
AI.result: 在两个记忆系统、三个模型和三个基准测试上，RBC将平均成功率提升至66.9，而使用完整手册为55.5，不使用手册为54.1，由智能体自行判断保留教训为53.8。
AI.conclusion: 以随机实验测量的因果效果来策展经验教训，优于让智能体自行判断，能显著且稳定地提升语言模型智能体在多步任务上的表现。

title: Estimating Surprisal from the Speech Signal
summary: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.

AI.tldr: 本文绕过文本瓶颈，用语音语言模型直接从语音信号估计surprisal，并提出重要性采样估计器将surprisal定义在抽象语言单位上，通过瞳孔数据验证其在口语理解中的预测能力。
AI.motivation: surprisal理论虽主要针对口语，但实证检验几乎完全依赖书面文本：常用做法是用文本训练的LM在转写文本上估计surprisal，形成"文本瓶颈"，限制了该理论在口语模态下的评估。
AI.method: 用语音LM直接从语音信号估计surprisal，去除文本瓶颈。针对"surprisal应定义在具体声学实现还是抽象语言单位"的问题，引入重要性采样估计器，借助TTS模型生成多种实现并对实现边缘化，从而近似抽象单位的概率。基于听音研究的瞳孔测量数据，在多个粒度上、用多个语音LM进行检验。
AI.result: 重要性采样估计的surprisal对单词层面瞳孔扩张的预测优于具体实现层面的surprisal；亚词级单位的surprisal也能预测瞳孔扩张。但在整体上，无论来源如何，surprisal都不是瞳孔大小变化的强预测因子。
AI.conclusion: surprisal可以在不依赖文本的情况下估计，且对单词的不同实现进行边缘化更能预测词汇加工努力；然而总体上surprisal对瞳孔变化的预测力较弱。

title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
summary: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
